public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalAnswerTapesTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixes
open ActualRawSignedStaticCeiling (RawSyntax)
open ActualRawCanonicalZeroReplay (AnswerCode SequenceCode stepCode replayCode)
open ActualRawCanonicalAnswerTapes (candidateTapes)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (groupRaw)

abbrev Candidate := SequenceCode × RawSyntax

def available (s : RawSyntax) : List AnswerCode := candidateTapes (groupRaw s.2)

def extendCandidate (p : Candidate × AnswerCode) : Option Candidate :=
  (stepCode (p.1.2,p.2)).map fun state => (p.1.1 ++ [p.2],state)

def children (entry : Candidate) : List Candidate :=
  (available entry.2).filterMap (fun tape => extendCandidate (entry,tape))

def nextLevel (entries : List Candidate) : List Candidate := entries.flatMap children

def level (start : RawSyntax) : Nat → List Candidate
  | 0 => [([],start)]
  | n+1 => nextLevel (level start n)

def prefixes (fuel : Nat) (start : RawSyntax) : List Candidate :=
  (List.range (fuel+1)).flatMap (level start)

/-- Precisely the structural supplied-answer paths whose next tape
was emitted by that state's own canonical label-pair width, and whose
one zero syntax step succeeded. No actual read or truth assertions. -/
inductive CandidatePath (start : RawSyntax) : SequenceCode → RawSyntax → Prop where
  | nil : CandidatePath start [] start
  | snoc {tapes : SequenceCode} {s t : RawSyntax} {answer : AnswerCode} :
      CandidatePath start tapes s →
      answer ∈ available s →
      stepCode (s,answer) = some t →
      CandidatePath start (tapes ++ [answer]) t

def ExactRawZeroPrefixLevels : Prop :=
  ∀ (start : RawSyntax) (n : Nat) (entry : Candidate),
    entry ∈ level start n ↔ CandidatePath start entry.1 entry.2 ∧ entry.1.length = n

def ExactRawZeroPrefixEnumeration : Prop :=
  ∀ (fuel : Nat) (start : RawSyntax) (entry : Candidate),
    entry ∈ prefixes fuel start ↔ CandidatePath start entry.1 entry.2 ∧ entry.1.length ≤ fuel

def ExactRawZeroPrefixReplay : Prop :=
  ∀ (fuel : Nat) (start : RawSyntax) (entry : Candidate),
    entry ∈ prefixes fuel start →
      replayCode (entry.1,start) = some entry.2 ∧ entry.1.length ≤ fuel

def ExactRawZeroPrefixEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec available ∧ Primrec nextLevel ∧ Primrec₂ level ∧ Primrec₂ prefixes

def FullActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixes : Prop :=
  ExactRawZeroPrefixLevels ∧ ExactRawZeroPrefixEnumeration ∧ ExactRawZeroPrefixReplay ∧
    ExactRawZeroPrefixEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixes

def ExactActualCanonicalBudgetInclusion : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (source target : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers source target →
      let raw := encodeSyntax (eraseState source)
      entry answers target ∈ prefixes (syntaxBudgetCode r raw.2) raw

def ExactFundedStoppingCandidateInclusion : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (source : ReadState),
    liftedReads f ρ source.reads → RankBound r top source → LongState source →
    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf source) → PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf source) →
    ∃ (answers : List (List Answer)) (target : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers source target ∧ StopsAt f B ρ r top target ∧
      (let raw := encodeSyntax (eraseState source)
       entry answers target ∈ prefixes (syntaxBudgetCode r raw.2) raw)

def FullActualRawCanonicalZeroTraceInclusion : Prop :=
  ExactActualZeroCandidateEdge ∧ ExactActualCanonicalCandidateTrace ∧
    ExactActualCanonicalBudgetInclusion ∧ ExactFundedStoppingCandidateInclusion

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalZeroTraceInclusion

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet append)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape packet)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds RouteHolds routes)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)

def cutoffPacket (minimum : Nat) : Packet :=
  ([],.atom (.nonnegative (-(minimum : Int),[(1,.variable 0)])))

def bounded (minimum : Nat) (p : Packet) : Packet := append (cutoffPacket minimum) p

def project (minimum : Nat) (p : Packet) : Packet :=
  let q := bounded minimum p
  (q.1,eliminatePreparedFormula q.2)

def LowerHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (p : Packet) : Prop :=
  ∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top baseline p.1 ν ∧ p.2.eval ν

def ExactChosenRouteProjection : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top minimum : Nat) (p : Packet),
    Shape p →
    (project minimum p).1 = p.1 ∧ Shape (project minimum p) ∧
    (∀ n ∈ (project minimum p).2.variables, 0 < n) ∧
    (LowerHolds f baseline top (project minimum p) ↔
      ∃ z : Nat, minimum ≤ z ∧ PacketHolds f baseline top z p)

/-- Each alternative retains its own actual lower table. The exterior
prior can be transported only if its explicit replay law is paid. -/
def ExactSignedRouteUnionProjection : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top minimum fuel : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (s : SyntaxState) (prior : (Nat → Nat) → Prop),
    (∀ z : Nat, minimum ≤ z → (prior (Function.update baseline top z) ↔ prior baseline)) →
    ((prior baseline ∧ ∃ path ∈ routes top test positive fuel s,
        LowerHolds f baseline top (project minimum (packet test positive path))) ↔
      ∃ z : Nat, minimum ≤ z ∧ prior (Function.update baseline top z) ∧
        ∃ path ∈ routes top test positive fuel s, RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive path)

def FullActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection : Prop :=
  ExactChosenRouteProjection ∧ ExactSignedRouteUnionProjection

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection

1	module
2	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessorTargets
3	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxLinearTerminalTargets
4	
5	@[expose] public section
6	namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutes
7	open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
8	open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
9	open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
10	open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState successor)
11	open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (normalizedTerms)
12	open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (nodePattern nodePacket nodeCoefficient StaticActive)
13	open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
14	open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
15	open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
16	
17	inductive Tip where
18	  | linear (packet : Packet)
19	  | signed (coef : Int)
20	
21	structure Route where
22	  guards : List Packet
23	  tip : Tip
24	
25	def nonlinear : LowerOperand → Bool
26	  | .coordinate _ => false
27	  | .ordinary _ (.iterate n) => decide (0 < n)
28	  | .ordinary _ (.entry ..) | .count .. => true
29	
30	def activeTest (top : Nat) (t : WeightedOperand) : Bool :=
31	  decide (t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ t.2.rank = top) && nonlinear t.2
32	
33	noncomputable def active (top : Nat) (raw : List WeightedOperand) : Bool :=
34	  (normalizedTerms raw).any (activeTest top)
35	
36	/-- Every guard on the chosen route gets its own actual correlated tied
37	lower table, all at the same original control and raw baseline. No
38	table belonging only to an unchosen successor is required to be live. -/
39	def PacketHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (p : Packet) : Prop :=
40	  ∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top baseline p.1 ν ∧ p.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)
41	
42	def TipHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
43	    Tip → Prop
44	  | .linear p => PacketHolds f baseline top z p
45	  | .signed coef => test.test.atPolarity positive coef
46	
47	def RouteHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
48	    (route : Route) : Prop :=
49	  (∀ g ∈ route.guards, PacketHolds f baseline top z g) ∧ TipHolds f baseline top z test positive route.tip
50	
51	def prefixGuard (g : Packet) (route : Route) : Route := ⟨g::route.guards,route.tip⟩
52	
53	noncomputable def linearRoute (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) : Route :=
54	  ⟨[],.linear (ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.packet top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩
55	
56	noncomputable def signedRoute (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (answer : List Answer) : Route :=
57	  ⟨[nodePacket s.terms top answer],.signed (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer)⟩
58	
59	noncomputable def branchRoutes (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (next : SyntaxState → List Route)
60	    (answer : List Answer) : List Route :=
61	  if nodeCoefficient s.terms answer = 0 then
62	    match successor s.constant s.terms answer with
63	    | none => []
64	    | some out => (next out).map (prefixGuard (nodePacket s.terms top answer))
65	  else [signedRoute top s answer]
66	
67	noncomputable def nodeRoutes (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
68	    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) : List Route :=
69	  if active top s.terms then (nodePattern s.terms).flatMap (branchRoutes top s next)
70	  else [linearRoute top test positive s]
71	
72	/-- Fuel counts allowed zero edges only. A nonzero or linear terminal is
73	still a candidate at zero fuel. Invalid candidate syntax is not a leaf. -/
74	noncomputable def routes (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
75	    Nat → SyntaxState → List Route
76	  | 0,s => nodeRoutes top test positive s (fun _ => [])
77	  | n+1,s => nodeRoutes top test positive s (routes top test positive n)
78	
79	def ExactActiveSyntax : Prop :=
80	  ∀ (top : Nat) (raw : List WeightedOperand), active top raw = true ↔ StaticActive top raw
81	
82	def ExactTypedRouteLayout : Prop :=
83	  ∀ (top n : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),
84	    route ∈ routes top test positive n s ↔
85	      (¬ StaticActive top s.terms ∧ route = linearRoute top test positive s) ∨
86	      (StaticActive top s.terms ∧ ∃ answer ∈ nodePattern s.terms,
87	        (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer ≠ 0 ∧ route = signedRoute top s answer) ∨
88	        (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer = 0 ∧ ∃ k out, n = k+1 ∧
89	          successor s.constant s.terms answer = some out ∧
90	          ∃ tail ∈ routes top test positive k out,
91	            route = prefixGuard (nodePacket s.terms top answer) tail))
92	
93	def ExactPathLocalAvailability : Prop :=
94	  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
95	    (g : Packet) (tail : Route),
96	    RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive (prefixGuard g tail) ↔
97	      PacketHolds f baseline top z g ∧ RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive tail
98	
99	def FullActualBoundedSignedRoutes : Prop :=
100	  ExactActiveSyntax ∧ ExactTypedRouteLayout ∧ ExactPathLocalAvailability
101	
102	end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutes

  | .coordinate _ => false
  | .ordinary _ (.iterate n) => decide (0 < n)
  | .ordinary _ (.entry ..) | .count .. => true

def activeTest (top : Nat) (t : WeightedOperand) : Bool :=
  decide (t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ t.2.rank = top) && nonlinear t.2

noncomputable def active (top : Nat) (raw : List WeightedOperand) : Bool :=
  (normalizedTerms raw).any (activeTest top)

/-- Every guard on the chosen route gets its own actual correlated tied
lower table, all at the same original control and raw baseline. No
table belonging only to an unchosen successor is required to be live. -/
def PacketHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (p : Packet) : Prop :=
  ∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top baseline p.1 ν ∧ p.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)

def TipHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    Tip → Prop
  | .linear p => PacketHolds f baseline top z p
  | .signed coef => test.test.atPolarity positive coef

def RouteHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (route : Route) : Prop :=
  (∀ g ∈ route.guards, PacketHolds f baseline top z g) ∧ TipHolds f baseline top z test positive route.tip

def prefixGuard (g : Packet) (route : Route) : Route := ⟨g::route.guards,route.tip⟩

noncomputable def linearRoute (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) : Route :=
  ⟨[],.linear (ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.packet top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩

noncomputable def signedRoute (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (answer : List Answer) : Route :=
  ⟨[nodePacket s.terms top answer],.signed (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer)⟩

noncomputable def branchRoutes (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (next : SyntaxState → List Route)
    (answer : List Answer) : List Route :=
  if nodeCoefficient s.terms answer = 0 then
    match successor s.constant s.terms answer with
    | none => []
    | some out => (next out).map (prefixGuard (nodePacket s.terms top answer))
  else [signedRoute top s answer]

noncomputable def nodeRoutes (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) : List Route :=
  if active top s.terms then (nodePattern s.terms).flatMap (branchRoutes top s next)
  else [linearRoute top test positive s]

/-- Fuel counts allowed zero edges only. A nonzero or linear terminal is
still a candidate at zero fuel. Invalid candidate syntax is not a leaf. -/
noncomputable def routes (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    Nat → SyntaxState → List Route
  | 0,s => nodeRoutes top test positive s (fun _ => [])
  | n+1,s => nodeRoutes top test positive s (routes top test positive n)

def ExactActiveSyntax : Prop :=
  ∀ (top : Nat) (raw : List WeightedOperand), active top raw = true ↔ StaticActive top raw

def ExactTypedRouteLayout : Prop :=
  ∀ (top n : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),
    route ∈ routes top test positive n s ↔
      (¬ StaticActive top s.terms ∧ route = linearRoute top test positive s) ∨
      (StaticActive top s.terms ∧ ∃ answer ∈ nodePattern s.terms,
        (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer ≠ 0 ∧ route = signedRoute top s answer) ∨
        (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer = 0 ∧ ∃ k out, n = k+1 ∧
          successor s.constant s.terms answer = some out ∧
          ∃ tail ∈ routes top test positive k out,
            route = prefixGuard (nodePacket s.terms top answer) tail))

def ExactPathLocalAvailability : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (g : Packet) (tail : Route),
    RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive (prefixGuard g tail) ↔
      PacketHolds f baseline top z g ∧ RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive tail

def FullActualBoundedSignedRoutes : Prop :=
  ExactActiveSyntax ∧ ExactTypedRouteLayout ∧ ExactPathLocalAvailability

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutes

@[expose] public section

open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState successor)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Route PacketHolds RouteHolds routes linearRoute)
open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (StaticActive nodePattern nodePacket nodeCoefficient)

def stateSyntax (s : ReadState) : SyntaxState := ⟨s.constant,syntaxOf s⟩

/-- Three independent paid quantities: true annotation/transfer tails,
the true finite comparison maximum, and the signed terminal cutoff.
These are numerical hypotheses at the original rank assignment, not
statements that arbitrary values pay all three. -/
structure RunContext (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat)
    (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState) : Prop where
  chosen : SelectedWithThreshold f B
  lower : LowerStrict baseline top
  above : AboveLower baseline top z
  live : liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) initial.reads
  ranks : RankBound r top initial
  long : LongState initial
  transferTail : PaidGlobalTail B r (Function.update baseline top z) (syntaxOf initial)
  comparisonTail : PaidComparisonCeiling B r (Function.update baseline top z) (syntaxOf initial)
  signTail : terminalCutoffCeiling r initial ≤ z

def RealBranch (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat)
    (r top z : Nat) (s : ReadState) (a : List Answer) : Prop :=
  let raw := syntaxOf s
  let coef := nodeCoefficient raw a
  (coef = 0 ∧ ∃ out : ReadState,
      ZeroEdge f B (extend baseline top z) r top s out ∧
        successor s.constant raw a = some (stateSyntax out)) ∨
  (coef ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
    ((test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s)) ↔ test.test.atPolarity positive coef))

def ExactReachedLinearRoute : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    RunContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (n : Nat) (s : ReadState), Trace f B (extend baseline top z) r top n initial s →
    ¬ StaticActive top (syntaxOf s) →
    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
      (RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive (linearRoute top test positive (stateSyntax s)) ↔
        test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s))

def ExactReachedNonlinearRoute : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    RunContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (n : Nat) (s : ReadState), Trace f B (extend baseline top z) r top n initial s →
    StaticActive top (syntaxOf s) →
      (∃ a ∈ nodePattern (syntaxOf s), PacketHolds f baseline top z (nodePacket (syntaxOf s) top a)) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ nodePattern (syntaxOf s), PacketHolds f baseline top z (nodePacket (syntaxOf s) top a) →
        RealBranch f B baseline r top z s a

def ExactBoundedSignedRouteSoundness : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    RunContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (fuel n : Nat) (s : ReadState),
      Trace f B (extend baseline top z) r top n initial s →
      ∀ route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s),
        RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive route →
          test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s)

def ExactBoundedSignedRouteCompleteness : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    RunContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (fuel n : Nat) (s : ReadState),
      Trace f B (extend baseline top z) r top n initial s →
      stateCharge r s ≤ fuel →
      test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s) →
        ∃ route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s),
          RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive route

def ExactActualSufficientSignedRoutes : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    RunContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
      (test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue initial) ↔
        ∃ route ∈ routes top test positive (syntaxBudget r (syntaxOf initial)) (stateSyntax initial),
          RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive route)

def FullActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics : Prop :=
  ExactReachedLinearRoute ∧ ExactReachedNonlinearRoute ∧
  ExactBoundedSignedRouteSoundness ∧ ExactBoundedSignedRouteCompleteness ∧ ExactActualSufficientSignedRoutes

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridgeTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjectionTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection (project LowerHolds)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (LowerStrict)
open ActualTraceSignCutoff (terminalCutoffCeiling)
open ActualPaidOrderedSyntaxReads (PaidReadCeiling readCeiling)
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (commonMinimum dummy)
open ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute (modulusMinimum)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (MixedRow Ready matrixMinimum tuples)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (tuplePacket)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow ClauseHolds)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (properClauses compileRow)

noncomputable def staticNeed (B r : Nat) : MixedRow → Nat
  | .signed row => max (commonMinimum B r row.source) (terminalCutoffCeiling r (dummy row.source))
  | .modular m s _ => modulusMinimum B m s

noncomputable def rowNeed (B r : Nat) (row : BitRow) : Nat :=
  max (readCeiling row.1.2.2) (staticNeed B r (compileRow row))

noncomputable def clauseNeed (B r : Nat) (rows : List BitRow) : Nat :=
  rows.foldr (fun row tail => max (rowNeed B r row) tail) 0

noncomputable def familyNeed (B r : Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)) : Nat :=
  (properClauses family).foldr (fun rows tail => max (clauseNeed B r rows) tail) 0

def rankedPredecessor (top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) : Nat :=
  if top = 0 then 0 else baseline (top-1)+1

/-- The family threshold itself is independent of the valuation.
Strict rank replay adds only the previous actual raw rank plus one. -/
noncomputable def highMinimum (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)) : Nat :=
  max (familyNeed B r family) (rankedPredecessor top baseline)

structure OriginalSetup (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)) : Prop where
  strict : LowerStrict baseline top
  scope : ∀ rows ∈ family, ∀ row ∈ rows, ∀ t ∈ row.1.2.2, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top
  lower : ∀ rows ∈ properClauses family, ∀ row ∈ rows, ∀ t ∈ row.1.2.2, t.2.rank < top →
    familyNeed B r family ≤ baseline t.2.rank

noncomputable def highPackets (r top : Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)) : List Packet :=
  (properClauses family).flatMap (fun rows => (tuples r top (rows.map compileRow)).map tuplePacket)

def SourceFamily (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)) : Prop :=
  ∃ rows ∈ family, ClauseHolds f ρ rows

def ExactOriginalLiteralReady : Prop :=
  ∀ (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)),
    OriginalSetup B r top baseline family →
    ∀ (z : Nat), highMinimum B r top baseline family ≤ z →
    ∀ rows ∈ properClauses family,
      (∀ row ∈ rows, PaidReadCeiling (Function.update baseline top z) row.1.2.2) ∧
      (∀ row ∈ rows.map compileRow, Ready B r top baseline row) ∧
      matrixMinimum B r top baseline (rows.map compileRow) ≤ z

def ExactRankedLiteralHigh : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)),
      OriginalSetup B r top baseline family →
      ∀ (z : Nat), highMinimum B r top baseline family ≤ z →
        (SourceFamily f (Function.update baseline top z) family ↔
          ∃ q ∈ highPackets r top family, PacketHolds f baseline top z q)

def ExactRankedLiteralHighProjection : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)),
      OriginalSetup B r top baseline family →
      ∀ prior : (Nat → Nat) → Prop,
        let minimum := highMinimum B r top baseline family
        (∀ z : Nat, minimum ≤ z → (prior (Function.update baseline top z) ↔ prior baseline)) →
        ((prior baseline ∧ ∃ q ∈ highPackets r top family,
            LowerHolds f baseline top (project minimum q)) ↔
          ∃ z : Nat, minimum ≤ z ∧ prior (Function.update baseline top z) ∧
            SourceFamily f (Function.update baseline top z) family)

def FullOriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh : Prop :=
  ExactOriginalLiteralReady ∧ ExactRankedLiteralHigh ∧ ExactRankedLiteralHighProjection

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh

noncomputable def lowerFamily (top minimum : Nat) (qs : List Packet) : List Residual :=
  (keep top qs).filterMap (decodeRoute minimum)

def rows (p : Residual) : List Row := availabilityRows p.ops ++ p.atoms

def LowerMatrix (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (p : Residual) : Prop :=
  MatrixAccepts f ρ p.ops p.formula true p.atoms

def ExactKeptActualRoute : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (qs : List Packet),
    ((∃ q ∈ qs, LowerHolds f ρ top q) ↔ ∃ q ∈ keep top qs, LowerHolds f ρ top q)

def ExactDecodedActualResidual : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top minimum : Nat) (q : Packet), Shape q → StrictLower top q.1 →
    ∃ output : Residual, decodeRoute minimum q = some output ∧
      output.ops = q.1 ∧
      supportSet (rows output) = argumentNames q.1 ∧
      (∀ rank ∈ supportSet (rows output), rank < top) ∧
      (LowerHolds f ρ top (project minimum q) ↔ LowerMatrix f ρ output)

def ExactActualLowerRouteFamily : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top minimum : Nat) (qs : List Packet),
    (∀ q ∈ qs, Shape q) →
      (∀ p ∈ lowerFamily top minimum qs, ∀ rank ∈ supportSet (rows p), rank < top) ∧
      ((∃ q ∈ qs, LowerHolds f ρ top (project minimum q)) ↔
        ∃ p ∈ lowerFamily top minimum qs, LowerMatrix f ρ p)

def ExactActualLowerRouteDimension : Prop :=
  ∀ (top minimum : Nat) (qs : List Packet) (source : List Row),
    (∀ q ∈ qs, Shape q) → (∀ rank ≤ top, rank ∈ supportSet source) →
    ∀ p ∈ lowerFamily top minimum qs,
      supportSet (rows p) ⊆ (supportSet source).erase top ∧ dimension (rows p) < dimension source

def FullActualGreatestRouteResidual : Prop :=
  ExactKeptActualRoute ∧ ExactDecodedActualResidual ∧ ExactActualLowerRouteFamily ∧ ExactActualLowerRouteDimension

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestRouteResidual

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjectionTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHighTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet append)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape)
open ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection (project LowerHolds)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor)

def predecessorPacket (top : Nat) : Packet :=
  ([.coordinate (top-1)],.atom (.nonnegative (-1,[(1,.variable 0),(-1,.variable 1)])))

/-- The predecessor remains a symbolic real bare lower slot. Nothing
from the actual baseline valuation appears in this output syntax. -/
def prepend (top : Nat) (p : Packet) : Packet :=
  if top = 0 then p else append (predecessorPacket top) p

def ExactSymbolicPredecessorGuard : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat), 0 < top →
    Shape (predecessorPacket top) ∧
    (PacketHolds f baseline top z (predecessorPacket top) ↔ baseline (top-1)+1 ≤ z)

def ExactSymbolicPredecessorAppend : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (p : Packet), Shape p →
    Shape (prepend top p) ∧
      (PacketHolds f baseline top z (prepend top p) ↔
        rankedPredecessor top baseline ≤ z ∧ PacketHolds f baseline top z p)

def ExactSymbolicPredecessorProjection : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top cutoff : Nat) (p : Packet), Shape p →
    (LowerHolds f baseline top (project cutoff (prepend top p)) ↔
      ∃ z : Nat, max cutoff (rankedPredecessor top baseline) ≤ z ∧ PacketHolds f baseline top z p)

def FullActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection : Prop :=
  ExactSymbolicPredecessorGuard ∧ ExactSymbolicPredecessorAppend ∧ ExactSymbolicPredecessorProjection

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove
open OrdinalComparison
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family Holds exactGuardedResidualUnion)
open ActualBitFamilyLowSlices (coordinates)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern rename)
open ActualRankChartPrototype (readWithin seed)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition exactLowerRankChartRows lowerChart)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (highPackets rankedPredecessor highPacketShape exactRankedLiteralHigh)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend exactSymbolicPredecessorAppend exactSymbolicPredecessorProjection)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape)
open ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection (project LowerHolds)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (Residual rows exactActualLowerRouteFamily)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open OriginalMatrixLowDimension (supportSet)
open OriginalPrintedHighResidual (guardedRows)

open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked AllPaid exactGenericRankTransport amendedShapes)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (Supplied Valid renameIndex)

private theorem rankReads (family : Family) (names : List Nat) (p : Pattern)
    (support : Supplied family names) (good : Valid names p)
    (C : Nat) (lower outside : Nat → Nat) (chart : LowerChartCondition C (top p) lower)
    (z : Nat) (cut : seed C p lower ≤ z) :
    AllPaid C family (readWithin names p lower outside z) := by
  intro n used
  have present : n ∈ names := (support.2 n).mpr used
  have scope : rename p n ≤ top p := by
    have lt := renameIndex names p good n present
    change rename p n ≤ p.1-1
    omega
  rw [readWithin,if_pos present]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le scope with smaller | greatest
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_lt smaller)]
    exact chart.1 _ smaller
  · rw [greatest,Function.update_self]
    exact (le_max_left _ _).trans cut

private theorem residualPacket (f lower : Nat → Nat) (C : Nat) (family : Family) (p : Pattern) :
    (∃ out ∈ outputs C family p, ActualGreatestRouteResidual.LowerMatrix f lower out) ↔
      ∃ z : Nat, seed C p lower ≤ z ∧
        ∃ q ∈ highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family), PacketHolds f lower (top p) z q := by
  let qs := highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)
  let greatest := top p
  let compiled := qs.map (prepend greatest)
  have reduction := (exactActualLowerRouteFamily f lower greatest C compiled (amendedShapes p family)).2
  refine reduction.symm.trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨output,atOutput,lifted⟩
    obtain ⟨q,used,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp atOutput
    have shape := highPacketShape p.1 greatest (ranked p family) q used
    obtain ⟨z,high,passes⟩ := (exactSymbolicPredecessorProjection f lower greatest C q shape).mp lifted
    exact ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩

    have shape := highPacketShape p.1 greatest (ranked p family) q used

  intro f B C chosen family names support large p good lower outside
  let greatest := top p
  have chart := (exactLowerRankChartRows f lower C greatest).1
  have decode := (exactGuardedResidualUnion f lower C greatest (outputs C family p)).2
  have source (funded : LowerChartCondition C greatest lower) (z : Nat) (within : seed C p lower ≤ z) :
      (∃ q ∈ highPackets p.1 greatest (ranked p family), PacketHolds f lower greatest z q) ↔
      Holds f (readWithin names p lower outside z) family := by
    have setup := exactAboveHighSetup B C family names large p support good lower funded
    have same (k : Nat) (used : k ∈ coordinates family) :
        Function.update lower greatest z (rename p k) = readWithin names p lower outside z k := by
      have named : k ∈ names := (support.2 k).mpr used
      rw [readWithin,if_pos named]
    exact (exactRankedLiteralHigh f B chosen p.1 greatest lower (ranked p family)
      setup.1 z (setup.2 z within)).symm.trans
        (exactGenericRankTransport f (readWithin names p lower outside z)
          (Function.update lower greatest z) family p same).symm
  constructor
  · intro hold
    obtain ⟨out,inOut,lowerGuard,lowerData⟩ := decode.mp hold
    have ready := chart.mp lowerGuard
    obtain ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩ := (residualPacket f lower C family p).mp ⟨out,inOut,lowerData⟩
    exact ⟨ready,z,high,rankReads family names p support good C lower outside ready z high,
      (source ready z high).mp ⟨q,used,passes⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨ready,z,high,_,actual⟩
    obtain ⟨out,member,lowers⟩ := (residualPacket f lower C family p).mpr ⟨z,high,(source ready z high).mpr actual⟩
    exact decode.mpr ⟨out,member,chart.mpr ready,lowers⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove

import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesCoverageProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesEnumerateProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesRealizationProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankChartPrototypeReadProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family Holds)
open ActualBitFamilyLowSlices (coordinates dimension)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern actualPattern guard realized rename exactActualBranchCoverage
  exactPatternEnumeration exactBranchRealization)
open ActualRankChartPrototype (Consistent exactChartConsistency seed readWithin)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)

open ActualBitFamilyHigh (AllPaid)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (Valid Supplied exactNamedCharts)

private theorem actualChartValues (family : Family) (names : List Nat) (supports : Supplied family names)
    (p : Pattern) (member : p ∈ ActualFiniteOrderBranches.patterns names)
    (θ : Nat → Nat) (checked : (guard p).eval θ) (nonempty : 0 < dimension family)
    (C : Nat) (paid : AllPaid C family θ) :
    0 < p.1 ∧ LowerChartCondition C (top p) (realized θ p) ∧
      seed C p (realized θ p) ≤ realized θ p (top p) ∧
      readWithin names p (realized θ p) θ (realized θ p (top p)) = θ := by
  let greatest := top p
  let base := realized θ p
  obtain ⟨_,keys,bounds,onto⟩ := (exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp member
  obtain ⟨strict,slots,ties⟩ := exactBranchRealization θ names p member checked
  have width : 0 < p.1 := by
    obtain ⟨n,used⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp nonempty
    have input : n ∈ names := (supports.2 n).mpr used
    exact (Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt (ties n input).1
  have payRank (i : Nat) (used : i < p.1) : C ≤ base i := by
    obtain ⟨e,member,eq⟩ := onto i used
    have n : e.1 ∈ names := by
      rw [← keys]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,member,rfl⟩
    change C ≤ realized θ p i
    rw [← eq,(slots e member).2]
    exact paid e.1 ((supports.2 e.1).mp n)
  have topWidth : greatest < p.1 := by
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  have chart : LowerChartCondition C greatest base :=
    ⟨fun i h => payRank i (h.trans topWidth),fun i j lt _ => strict lt⟩
  have pred : rankedPredecessor greatest base ≤ base greatest := by
    by_cases zero : greatest = 0
    · simp only [rankedPredecessor,if_pos zero,Nat.zero_le]
    · rw [rankedPredecessor,if_neg zero]
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (strict (show greatest-1 < greatest by omega))
  refine ⟨width,chart,max_le (payRank greatest topWidth) pred,?_⟩
  funext n
  by_cases used : n ∈ names
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_pos used]
    change Function.update base greatest (base greatest) (rename p n) = θ n
    rw [Function.update_eq_self]
    exact (ties n used).2
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_neg used]

theorem exactAboveHighExistential : ExactAboveHighExistential := by
  intro f B C chosen family names supplied large nonempty
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ,paid,truth⟩
    let p := actualPattern θ names
    obtain ⟨member,checked⟩ := exactActualBranchCoverage θ names
    obtain ⟨width,lower,high,actual⟩ := actualChartValues family names supplied p member θ checked nonempty C paid
    have good : Valid names p := ⟨member,width,exactChartConsistency θ p checked⟩
    let base := realized θ p
    have rawTruth : Holds f (readWithin names p base θ (base (top p))) family := by
      rw [actual]
      exact truth
    have rawPaid : AllPaid C family (readWithin names p base θ (base (top p))) := by
      rw [actual]
      exact paid
    have childTruth := (exactAboveUniformChartChild f B C chosen family names supplied large p good base θ).mpr
      ⟨lower,base (top p),high,rawPaid,rawTruth⟩
    exact ⟨(p,child C family p),List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,(exactNamedCharts names p).mpr good,rfl⟩,base,childTruth⟩
  · rintro ⟨result,member,lower,truth⟩
    obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
    obtain ⟨_,z,_,paid,source⟩ :=
      (exactAboveUniformChartChild f B C chosen family names supplied large p good lower (fun _ => 0)).mp truth
    exact ⟨readWithin names p lower (fun _ => 0) z,paid,source⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove

private theorem guardedBelow (C greatest : Nat) (out : Residual)
    (lower : ∀ k ∈ supportSet (rows out), k < greatest) :
    ∀ k ∈ supportSet (guardedRows C greatest out), k < greatest := by
  intro k used
  obtain ⟨r,member,ranked⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp used)
  rcases List.mem_append.mp member with chart | residual
  · obtain ⟨row,atChart,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp chart
    obtain ⟨term,seen,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ranked
    exact ((exactLowerRankChartRows (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest).2 row atChart).2 term seen
  · exact lower k (List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨r,residual,ranked⟩))

theorem exactAboveHighDimension : ExactAboveHighDimension := by
  intro C family names supplied result member
  obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  let greatest := top p
  let qs := (highPackets p.1 greatest (ranked p family)).map (prepend greatest)
  let childFamily := child C family p
  have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
  have width : p.1 ≤ dimension family := by
    have chart := ((exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp good.1).1
    rw [← checkedLength family names supplied]
    exact chart
  have core := (exactActualLowerRouteFamily (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) greatest C qs (amendedShapes p family)).1
  have source := (exactGuardedResidualUnion (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest (outputs C family p)).1
  have scope (k : Nat) (inUnion : k ∈ coordinates childFamily) : k < greatest := by
    obtain ⟨clause,member,atClause⟩ := (coordinateClause childFamily k).mp inUnion

    change clause.map Prod.fst = guardedRows C greatest out at exactOut
    change k ∈ supportSet (clause.map Prod.fst) at atClause
    rw [exactOut] at atClause
    exact guardedBelow C greatest out (core out used) k atClause
  have subset : coordinates childFamily ⊆ Finset.range greatest :=
    fun k member => Finset.mem_range.mpr (scope k member)
  have bound : dimension childFamily ≤ greatest := by
    simpa only [Finset.card_range] using Finset.card_le_card subset
  have lower : greatest < p.1 := by
    have pos := good.2.1
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  exact ⟨scope,bound.trans_lt (lower.trans_le width)⟩

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSignedRouteCartesianTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestCongruenceRouteTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples
open OrdinalComparison
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (SignedRow rowPackets choices tuplePacket)
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (SourceHolds LowerSetup replayMinimum)
open ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute (SourceCongruence LowerModulusSetup modulusMinimum)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)

inductive MixedRow where
  | signed (row : SignedRow)
  | modular (modulus : Nat) (source : SyntaxState) (positive : Bool)

def Source (f ρ : Nat → Nat) : MixedRow → Prop
  | .signed row => SourceHolds f ρ row.source row.test row.positive
  | .modular m s positive => SourceCongruence f ρ m s positive

def Ready (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) : MixedRow → Prop
  | .signed row => LowerSetup B r top baseline row.source
  | .modular m s _ => LowerModulusSetup B top m baseline s

noncomputable def rowMinimum (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) : MixedRow → Nat
  | .signed row => replayMinimum B r top baseline row.source
  | .modular m s _ => modulusMinimum B m s

noncomputable def matrixMinimum (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (rows : List MixedRow) : Nat :=
  rows.foldr (fun row n => max (rowMinimum B r top baseline row) n) 0

noncomputable def alternatives (r top : Nat) : MixedRow → List Packet
  | .signed row => rowPackets r top row
  | .modular m s positive => [ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet top m s positive]

noncomputable def tuples (r top : Nat) (rows : List MixedRow) : List (List Packet) :=
  choices (rows.map (alternatives r top))

def MatrixSource (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (rows : List MixedRow) : Prop :=
  ∀ row ∈ rows, Source f ρ row

def ExactMixedMatrixMinimum : Prop :=
  ∀ (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (rows : List MixedRow) (z : Nat),
    matrixMinimum B r top baseline rows ≤ z ↔ ∀ row ∈ rows, rowMinimum B r top baseline row ≤ z

def ExactPaidMixedRow : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (row : MixedRow),
      Ready B r top baseline row → ∀ z : Nat, rowMinimum B r top baseline row ≤ z →
        (Source f (Function.update baseline top z) row ↔
          ∃ q ∈ alternatives r top row, PacketHolds f baseline top z q)

No individually projected existential witnesses are combined. -/

  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →

      ∀ z : Nat, matrixMinimum B r top baseline rows ≤ z →
        (MatrixSource f (Function.update baseline top z) rows ↔
          ∃ selected ∈ tuples r top rows, PacketHolds f baseline top z (tuplePacket selected))

def FullActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples : Prop :=
  ExactMixedMatrixMinimum ∧ ExactPaidMixedRow ∧ ExactMixedTupleShape ∧ ExactPaidMixedMatrixTuples

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples

open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection

open ActualPaidOrderedSyntaxReads (PaidReadCeiling)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (MixedRow Source MatrixSource)
open ActualInitialSignedCountCleanup (cleanup)

def originalSyntax (row : Row) : SyntaxState := ⟨row.2.1,row.2.2⟩

def AdmittedOperandRow (r : BitRow) : Prop :=
  r.1.1.Admitted ∧ ∀ t ∈ r.1.2.2, properOperand t.2

def AdmittedLiteralClause (rows : List BitRow) : Prop :=
  ∀ row ∈ rows, AdmittedOperandRow row

/-- A malformed actual original field prevents its whole row from
having a value. Never change its signed bit to false. -/
noncomputable def properClauses (family : List (List BitRow)) : List (List BitRow) :=
  family.filter (fun rows => @decide (AdmittedLiteralClause rows) (Classical.propDecidable _))

def compileRow (row : BitRow) : MixedRow :=
  let s := originalSyntax row.1
  match row.1.1 with
  | .equalZero => .signed ⟨cleanup s,.equalZero,row.2⟩
  | .nonnegative => .signed ⟨cleanup s,.nonnegative,row.2⟩
  | .positive => .signed ⟨cleanup s,.positive,row.2⟩
  | .congruence m => .modular m s row.2

def ExactActualRowReadState : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (c : Int) (ts : List WeightedOperand) (v : Int),
    (valueAt f ρ c ts v ↔ ∃ s : ReadState,
      stateSyntax s = ⟨c,ts⟩ ∧ liftedReads f ρ s.reads ∧ stateValue s = v)

def ExactLiteralRowProper : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (row : BitRow), RowHolds f ρ row → AdmittedOperandRow row

def ExactLiteralProperClauseFilter : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (family : List (List BitRow)),
    (∃ c ∈ family, ClauseHolds f ρ c) ↔
      ∃ c ∈ properClauses family, ClauseHolds f ρ c

/-- Only the signed order rows are cleaned. Their original pre-cleanup
reads remain owed; modular rows are literal and keep the same modulus. -/
def ExactLiteralMixedRowBridge : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (row : BitRow), AdmittedOperandRow row → PaidReadCeiling ρ row.1.2.2 →
      (RowHolds f ρ row ↔ Source f ρ (compileRow row))

def ExactLiteralMixedClauseBridge : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (rows : List BitRow), AdmittedLiteralClause rows →
      (∀ row ∈ rows, PaidReadCeiling ρ row.1.2.2) →
      (ClauseHolds f ρ rows ↔ MatrixSource f ρ (rows.map compileRow))

def FullOriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge : Prop :=
  ExactActualRowReadState ∧ ExactLiteralRowProper ∧ ExactLiteralProperClauseFilter ∧
    ExactLiteralMixedRowBridge ∧ ExactLiteralMixedClauseBridge

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixOrderBranchesTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalNormalizedMatrixPositiveSnapshotsTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open HeterogeneousSignedMatrixSlice (Row Snapshot actualRows)
open SignedRowSliceValue (valueAt)
open OriginalPlainTerminalMatrix (readBits accepts)
open OriginalNormalizedMatrixPositiveSnapshots (AllTrue)
open OriginalPrintedCircuitSequential (Gate)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixOrderBranches (SourceAccepts)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixInfiniteLow (circuit)
open PreparedProjection (PlainPreparedFormula)

abbrev BitRow := Row × Bool

def vectors : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (vectors n).map (List.cons false) ++ (vectors n).map (List.cons true)

def accepted (p : NormalForm.Formula) (positive : Bool) (n : Nat) : List (List Bool) :=
  (vectors n).filter (fun bits => decide (readBits p bits = some (positive,[])))

def zipBits : List Row → List Bool → List BitRow
  | r::rs,b::bs => (r,b)::zipBits rs bs
  | _,_ => []

def clauses (pre tail : List Row) (p : NormalForm.Formula) (positive : Bool) : List (List BitRow) :=
  (accepted p positive tail.length).map (fun bits => (pre.map (fun row => (row,true))) ++ zipBits tail bits)

def RowHolds (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (r : BitRow) : Prop :=
  r.1.1.Admitted ∧ ∃ v : Int, valueAt f ρ r.1.2.1 r.1.2.2 v ∧ r.1.1.atPolarity r.2 v

def ClauseHolds (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (rows : List BitRow) : Prop :=
  ∀ row ∈ rows, RowHolds f ρ row

def ExactAcceptedVectors : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : NormalForm.Formula) (positive : Bool) (n : Nat) (bits : List Bool),
    bits ∈ accepted p positive n ↔
      bits.length = n ∧ readBits p bits = some (positive,[])

def ExactBitTape : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (rows : List Row) (bits : List Bool), bits.length = rows.length →
    (ClauseHolds f ρ (zipBits rows bits) ↔
      ∃ snap : Snapshot, actualRows f ρ rows snap ∧ snap.map Prod.snd = bits)

def ExactPositivePrefixAndBooleanSuffix : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (pre tail : List Row) (p : NormalForm.Formula) (positive : Bool),
    ((∃ prefixSnap : Snapshot, actualRows f ρ pre prefixSnap ∧ AllTrue prefixSnap) ∧
      ∃ suffix : Snapshot, actualRows f ρ tail suffix ∧ accepts p positive suffix) ↔
    ∃ branch ∈ clauses pre tail p positive, ClauseHolds f ρ branch

/-- Positive original graph rows are emitted verbatim; only the exact
ordered original terminal Boolean syntax selects the signed suffix bits. -/
def ExactPrintedNormalizedBoolClauses : Prop :=
  ∀ (f θ : Nat → Nat) (known : List Nat) (gates : List Gate) (p : NormalForm.Formula),
    PlainPreparedFormula p → ∀ positive : Bool,
      (SourceAccepts f θ known gates p positive ↔
        ∃ branch ∈ clauses (OriginalNormalizedCircuitMatrix.rowsList (circuit known gates p))
          (OriginalPlainTerminalMatrix.rows p) p positive, ClauseHolds f θ branch)

def FullOriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses : Prop :=
  ExactAcceptedVectors ∧ ExactBitTape ∧ ExactPositivePrefixAndBooleanSuffix ∧ ExactPrintedNormalizedBoolClauses

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyHighTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyHighRankProof

import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGuardedResidualBitFamilyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLowerRankChartRowsProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyHigh
open OrdinalComparison
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family Holds exactGuardedResidualUnion)
open ActualBitFamilyLowSlices (coordinates)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern rename)
open ActualRankChartPrototype (readWithin seed)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition exactLowerRankChartRows lowerChart)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (highPackets rankedPredecessor highPacketShape exactRankedLiteralHigh)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend exactSymbolicPredecessorAppend exactSymbolicPredecessorProjection)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape)
open ActualSelectedSignedRouteProjection (project LowerHolds)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (Residual rows exactActualLowerRouteFamily)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open OriginalMatrixLowDimension (supportSet)
open OriginalPrintedHighResidual (guardedRows)

theorem amendedShapes (p : Pattern) (family : Family) :
    ∀ q ∈ (highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)).map (prepend (top p)), Shape q := by
  intro q member
  obtain ⟨src,old,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  exact (exactSymbolicPredecessorAppend (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (top p) 0 src
    (highPacketShape p.1 (top p) (ranked p family) src old)).1

private theorem rankReads (family : Family) (p : Pattern) (good : ValidChart family p)
    (C : Nat) (lower outside : Nat → Nat) (chart : LowerChartCondition C (top p) lower)
    (z : Nat) (cut : seed C p lower ≤ z) :
    AllPaid C family (readWithin (names family) p lower outside z) := by
  intro n used
  have present : n ∈ names family := Finset.mem_toList.mpr used
  have scope : rename p n ≤ top p := by
    have lt := renameWithin family p good n used
    change rename p n ≤ p.1-1
    omega
  rw [readWithin,if_pos present]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le scope with smaller | greatest
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_lt smaller)]
    exact chart.1 _ smaller
  · rw [greatest,Function.update_self]
    exact (le_max_left _ _).trans cut

private theorem residualPacket (f lower : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (family : Family) (p : Pattern) :
    (∃ out ∈ outputs B family p, ActualGreatestRouteResidual.LowerMatrix f lower out) ↔
      ∃ z : Nat, seed (cutoff B family) p lower ≤ z ∧
        ∃ q ∈ highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family), PacketHolds f lower (top p) z q := by
  let qs := highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)
  let greatest := top p
  let C := cutoff B family
  let compiled := qs.map (prepend greatest)
  have reduction := (exactActualLowerRouteFamily f lower greatest C compiled (amendedShapes p family)).2
  refine reduction.symm.trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨output,atOutput,lifted⟩
    obtain ⟨q,used,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp atOutput
    have shape := highPacketShape p.1 greatest (ranked p family) q used
    obtain ⟨z,high,passes⟩ := (exactSymbolicPredecessorProjection f lower greatest C q shape).mp lifted
    exact ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩
  · rintro ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩
    have shape := highPacketShape p.1 greatest (ranked p family) q used
    exact ⟨prepend greatest q,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨q,used,rfl⟩,
      (exactSymbolicPredecessorProjection f lower greatest C q shape).mpr ⟨z,high,passes⟩⟩

theorem exactGenericUniformChartChild : ExactGenericUniformChartChild := by
  intro f B chosen family p good lower outside
  let C := cutoff B family
  let greatest := top p
  have chart := (exactLowerRankChartRows f lower C greatest).1
  have decode := (exactGuardedResidualUnion f lower C greatest (outputs B family p)).2
  have source (funded : LowerChartCondition C greatest lower) (z : Nat) (within : seed C p lower ≤ z) :
      (∃ q ∈ highPackets p.1 greatest (ranked p family), PacketHolds f lower greatest z q) ↔
      Holds f (readWithin (names family) p lower outside z) family := by
    have setup := exactGenericHighSetup B family p good lower funded
    have same (k : Nat) (used : k ∈ coordinates family) :
        Function.update lower greatest z (rename p k) = readWithin (names family) p lower outside z k := by
      have named : k ∈ names family := Finset.mem_toList.mpr used
      rw [readWithin,if_pos named]
    exact (exactRankedLiteralHigh f B chosen p.1 greatest lower (ranked p family)
      setup.1 z (setup.2 z within)).symm.trans
        (exactGenericRankTransport f (readWithin (names family) p lower outside z)
          (Function.update lower greatest z) family p same).symm
  constructor
  · intro hold
    obtain ⟨out,inOut,lowerGuard,lowerData⟩ := decode.mp hold
    have ready := chart.mp lowerGuard
    obtain ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩ := (residualPacket f lower B family p).mp ⟨out,inOut,lowerData⟩
    exact ⟨ready,z,high,rankReads family p good C lower outside ready z high,
      (source ready z high).mp ⟨q,used,passes⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨ready,z,high,_,actual⟩
    obtain ⟨out,member,lowers⟩ := (residualPacket f lower B family p).mpr ⟨z,high,(source ready z high).mpr actual⟩
    exact decode.mpr ⟨out,member,chart.mpr ready,lowers⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyHigh

theorem certifyStage (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (high : HighProgram) (children : TypedHigh)
    (h : HighAtStage f B high children) : Certified f B (stageBound B) high children := by
  intro fs nonzero
  exact ⟨exactRawStageCutoffMajorant B fs,h fs nonzero⟩

theorem exactOriginalRawStageQuery : ExactOriginalRawStageQuery := by
  intro f B high children h
  exact exactOriginalRawConditionalQuery f B (stageBound B) high children
    (certifyStage f B high children h)

theorem exactOriginalRawStageFailure : ExactOriginalRawStageFailure := by
  intro f B high
  exact exactOriginalRawQueryFailure f (stageBound B) high

theorem originalRawStageQueryEffectivity : OriginalRawStageQueryEffectivity := by
  intro f B high hf hh
  have bound : Primrec (stageBound B) :=
    stageBoundPrimitive.comp (Primrec.const B : Primrec (fun _ : RawFamily => B)) Primrec.id
  exact originalRawConditionalQueryEffectivity f (stageBound B) high hf bound.to_comp hh

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery

theorem exactMixedMatrixMinimum : ExactMixedMatrixMinimum := by
  intro B r top baseline rows z
  induction rows with
  | nil =>
    exact ⟨fun _ row used => False.elim (List.not_mem_nil used),fun _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩

        exact (le_max_left _ _).trans above

      exact max_le (each row List.mem_cons_self)

private theorem allShape (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (rows : List MixedRow) :

    exact (rowExact row used).mpr (all (alternatives r top row) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,used,rfl⟩))

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuplesTargets

import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidSignedRouteReplayProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacketProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (exactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay)
open ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute (exactGreatestCongruenceShape exactGreatestCongruencePacket)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape exactEmittedRouteFamily)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (rowPackets)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)

theorem alternativesShape (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (row : MixedRow) :
    ∀ p ∈ alternatives r top row, Shape p := by
  intro p used
  cases row with
  | signed row =>
    obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    exact (exactEmittedRouteFamily f baseline top z (syntaxBudget r row.source.terms)
      row.test row.positive row.source).1 route member
  | modular m s positive =>
    have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp used
    subst p
    exact exactGreatestCongruenceShape top m s positive

theorem exactPaidMixedRow : ExactPaidMixedRow := by
  intro f B selected r top baseline row setup z minimum
  cases row with
  | signed row =>
    have source := exactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay f B selected r top baseline row.source setup z
      minimum row.test row.positive
    have packet := (exactEmittedRouteFamily f baseline top z (syntaxBudget r row.source.terms)
      row.test row.positive row.source).2
    refine source.trans (packet.symm.trans ?_)
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨route,member,passes⟩
      exact ⟨_,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨route,member,rfl⟩,passes⟩
    · rintro ⟨p,used,passes⟩
      obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
      exact ⟨route,member,passes⟩
  | modular m s positive =>
    refine (exactGreatestCongruencePacket f B selected baseline top m s setup z minimum positive).2.symm.trans ?_
    constructor
    · intro passes
      exact ⟨_,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,passes⟩
    · rintro ⟨p,h,passes⟩
      have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp h
      subst p
      exact passes

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawStageCutoffTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyRawLayoutProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyRawChartsProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyRawRankProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawMixedFamilyCeilingProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawStageCutoff
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (names encodeFamily exactRawFamilyNames)
open ActualBitFamilyRawCharts (nonemptyPatterns exactNonemptyPatterns)
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern patterns)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (Supplied cutoff)
open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (familyNeed)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (exactFamilyBound)
open ActualBitFamilyRawRank (exactRawRankCalibration)

theorem chartTapeLiteral (source : List Nat) (uniq : source.Nodup) :
    nonemptyPatterns source = ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh.charts source := by
  unfold nonemptyPatterns ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh.charts
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro p listed
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro pos
    have inRaw : p ∈ nonemptyPatterns source := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨listed,decide_eq_true pos⟩
    exact ⟨pos,((exactNonemptyPatterns source uniq p).mp inRaw).2.2⟩
  · exact And.left

private theorem familySource (family : Family) : Supplied family (names (encodeFamily family)) := by
  have uniq := (exactRawFamilyNames.1 (encodeFamily family)).2.1
  have supportEq := (exactRawFamilyNames.2 family).1
  refine ⟨uniq,?_⟩
  intro k
  rw [← supportEq,List.mem_toFinset]

theorem exactRawStageNamesAndCharts : ExactRawStageNamesAndCharts := by
  refine ⟨chartTapeLiteral,?_⟩
  intro family
  have source := familySource family
  exact ⟨source,chartTapeLiteral _ source.1⟩

theorem chartCostMajorant (B : Nat) (family : Family) (p : Pattern) :
    familyNeed B p.1 (ranked p family) ≤ chartCost B (encodeFamily family) p := by
  unfold chartCost
  rw [exactRawRankCalibration]
  exact exactFamilyBound B p.1 (ranked p family)

private theorem memCost {α : Type} (cost : α → Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α) (used : x ∈ xs) :
    cost x ≤ xs.foldr (fun a n => max (cost a) n) 0 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => cases used
  | cons a tail ih =>
      change cost x ≤ max (cost a) (tail.foldr (fun i n => max (cost i) n) 0)
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
      · subst x
        exact le_max_left _ _
      · exact (ih rest).trans (le_max_right _ _)

theorem exactRawRankedChartCost : ExactRawRankedChartCost := by
  refine ⟨chartCostMajorant,?_⟩
  intro B family p used
  have eq := (exactRawStageNamesAndCharts.2 family).2
  rw [← eq] at used
  exact (chartCostMajorant B family p).trans
    (memCost (chartCost B (encodeFamily family)) _ p used)

private theorem foldCostsLe {α : Type} (a b : α → Nat) (xs : List α)
    (wise : ∀ x : α, a x ≤ b x) :
    xs.foldr (fun x n => max (a x) n) 0 ≤ xs.foldr (fun x n => max (b x) n) 0 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact Nat.le_refl _
  | cons x xs ih => exact max_le_max (wise x) ih

theorem exactRawStageCutoffMajorant : ExactRawStageCutoffMajorant := by
  intro B family
  unfold cutoff stageBound
  rw [(exactRawStageNamesAndCharts.2 family).2]
  exact foldCostsLe _ _ _ (chartCostMajorant B family)

theorem exactTupleChoice : ExactTupleChoice := by
  intro rows
  induction rows with
  | nil =>
    intro ps
    constructor
    · intro used
      have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp used
      subst ps
      exact .nil
    · intro hs
      cases hs
      exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
  | cons row rows ih =>
    intro ps
    constructor
    · intro used
      obtain ⟨p,hp,rest⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp used
      obtain ⟨tail,ht,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp rest
      exact .cons hp ((ih tail).mp ht)
    · intro hs
      cases hs with
      | cons hp ht =>
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨_,hp,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_,(ih _).mpr ht,rfl⟩⟩

private theorem baseHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) :
    PacketHolds f baseline top z (tuplePacket []) :=
  ⟨fun _ => 0,fun j used => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero j used),True.intro⟩

theorem exactCartesianPacketEval : ExactCartesianPacketEval := by
  intro f baseline top z rows
  induction rows with
  | nil =>
    intro _
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩

    intro shape
    have tail := ih (fun family used => shape family (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ used))
    have decomp (ps : List Packet) (used : ps ∈ choices (row::rows)) :
        ∃ p ∈ row, ∃ rest ∈ choices rows, ps = p::rest := by
      obtain ⟨p,hp,member⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp used
      obtain ⟨rest,ht,eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member

    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ps,used,passes⟩
      obtain ⟨p,hp,rest,hr,rfl⟩ := decomp ps used
      obtain ⟨head,others⟩ := (ready p hp rest hr).2.mp passes
      have live := tail.2.mp ⟨rest,hr,others⟩
      intro family member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | lower
      · subst family
        exact ⟨p,hp,head⟩
      · exact live family lower
    · intro live
      obtain ⟨p,hp,head⟩ := live row List.mem_cons_self
      obtain ⟨rest,hr,others⟩ := tail.2.mpr (fun family used => live family (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ used))
      refine ⟨p::rest,List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨p,hp,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨rest,hr,rfl⟩⟩,?_⟩
      exact (ready p hp rest hr).2.mpr ⟨head,others⟩

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawSignedCleanupTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHighTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand WeightedCode encodeWeighted weightedTailCode)
open ActualRawSignedStaticCeiling (staticCode)
open ActualRawSignedCleanup (cleanupCode)
open ActualBitFamilyRawReadCeiling (rowCode)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (RawBitRow RawFamily encodeBitRow encodeFamily)
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute (modulusMinimum)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rowNeed clauseNeed familyNeed)

def rowBound (B r : Nat) (row : RawBitRow) : Nat :=
  let source := row.1
  let header := source.1
  let terms := source.2.2
  let internal :=
    if header.1 = 3 then weightedTailCode B header.2 terms
    else staticCode B r (cleanupCode source.2)
  max (rowCode source) internal

def clauseBound (B r : Nat) (rows : List RawBitRow) : Nat :=
  rows.foldr (fun row n => max (rowBound B r row) n) 0

/-- Cover even the clauses which the typed proper filter rejects.
This safe over-budget does not assert that any extra clause is valid. -/
def familyBound (B r : Nat) (family : RawFamily) : Nat :=
  family.foldr (fun rows n => max (clauseBound B r rows) n) 0

def ExactRawMixedRowMajorants : Prop :=
  (∀ (B m : Nat) (s : SyntaxState),
    weightedTailCode B m (s.terms.map encodeWeighted) = modulusMinimum B m s) ∧
  ∀ (B r : Nat) (row : BitRow), rowNeed B r row ≤ rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)

def ExactRawMixedFamilyMajorants : Prop :=
  (∀ (B r : Nat) (rows : List BitRow),
    clauseNeed B r rows ≤ clauseBound B r (rows.map encodeBitRow)) ∧
  ∀ (B r : Nat) (family : Family),
    familyNeed B r family ≤ familyBound B r (encodeFamily family)

def ExactRawMixedFamilyCeilingEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat × RawBitRow => rowBound p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
  Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat × List RawBitRow => clauseBound p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
  Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat × RawFamily => familyBound p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

def FullActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling : Prop :=
  ExactRawMixedRowMajorants ∧ ExactRawMixedFamilyMajorants ∧ ExactRawMixedFamilyCeilingEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling

21	
22	def dummy (s : SyntaxState) : ReadState := ⟨s.constant,s.terms.map fun t => (t,0)⟩
23	
24	noncomputable def commonMinimum (B r : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Nat :=
25	  max (readCeiling s.terms) (max (globalTail B r s.terms) (comparisonCeiling B r s.terms))
26	
27	/-- Literal upper-rank lower bound. No phantom preceding rank at top=0.
28	Its sign cutoff uses only original coefficients/operands and constant. -/
29	noncomputable def replayMinimum (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Nat :=
30	  max (commonMinimum B r s)
31	    (max (terminalCutoffCeiling r (dummy s))
32	      (if top = 0 then 0 else baseline (top-1) + 1))
33	
34	structure LowerSetup (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Prop where
35	  strict : LowerStrict baseline top
36	  scope : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top
37	  proper : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, properOperand t.2
38	  long : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, LongCountOperand t.2
39	  paid : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, t.2.rank < top → commonMinimum B r s ≤ baseline t.2.rank
40	
41	def SourceHolds (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Prop :=
42	  ∃ original : ReadState, stateSyntax original = s ∧ liftedReads f ρ original.reads ∧
43	    test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue original)
44	
45	def ExactSignCutoffFromSyntax : Prop :=
46	  ∀ (r : Nat) (s : ReadState), terminalCutoffCeiling r s = terminalCutoffCeiling r (dummy (stateSyntax s))
47	
48	def ExactActualReplayContext : Prop :=
49	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
50	    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState), LowerSetup B r top baseline s →
51	    ∀ (z : Nat), replayMinimum B r top baseline s ≤ z →
52	      (∃ original : ReadState, stateSyntax original = s ∧
53	        liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) original.reads) ∧
54	      ∀ original : ReadState, stateSyntax original = s →
55	        liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) original.reads →
56	          RunContext f B baseline r top z original
57	
58	def ExactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay : Prop :=
59	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
60	    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState), LowerSetup B r top baseline s →
61	    ∀ (z : Nat), replayMinimum B r top baseline s ≤ z →
62	    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
63	      (SourceHolds f (Function.update baseline top z) s test positive ↔
64	        ∃ path ∈ routes top test positive (syntaxBudget r s.terms) s,
65	          RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive path)

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (globalTail syntaxOf)
open ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling (comparisonCeiling)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState stateValue)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (LowerStrict)
open ActualShortCountCleanup (LongCountOperand)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualPaidOrderedSyntaxReads (readCeiling)
open ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics (RunContext stateSyntax)
open ActualTraceSignCutoff (terminalCutoffCeiling)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (routes RouteHolds)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualZeroClassReplacement (liftedReads)
open MixedSameRankResidue (properOperand)

def dummy (s : SyntaxState) : ReadState := ⟨s.constant,s.terms.map fun t => (t,0)⟩

noncomputable def commonMinimum (B r : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Nat :=
  max (readCeiling s.terms) (max (globalTail B r s.terms) (comparisonCeiling B r s.terms))

/-- Literal upper-rank lower bound. No phantom preceding rank at top=0.
Its sign cutoff uses only original coefficients/operands and constant. -/
noncomputable def replayMinimum (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Nat :=
  max (commonMinimum B r s)
    (max (terminalCutoffCeiling r (dummy s))
      (if top = 0 then 0 else baseline (top-1) + 1))

structure LowerSetup (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Prop where
  strict : LowerStrict baseline top
  scope : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top
  proper : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, properOperand t.2
  long : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, LongCountOperand t.2
  paid : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, t.2.rank < top → commonMinimum B r s ≤ baseline t.2.rank

def SourceHolds (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ original : ReadState, stateSyntax original = s ∧ liftedReads f ρ original.reads ∧
    test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue original)

def ExactSignCutoffFromSyntax : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Nat) (s : ReadState), terminalCutoffCeiling r s = terminalCutoffCeiling r (dummy (stateSyntax s))

def ExactActualReplayContext : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState), LowerSetup B r top baseline s →
    ∀ (z : Nat), replayMinimum B r top baseline s ≤ z →
      (∃ original : ReadState, stateSyntax original = s ∧
        liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) original.reads) ∧
      ∀ original : ReadState, stateSyntax original = s →
        liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) original.reads →
          RunContext f B baseline r top z original

def ExactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState), LowerSetup B r top baseline s →
    ∀ (z : Nat), replayMinimum B r top baseline s ≤ z →
    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
      (SourceHolds f (Function.update baseline top z) s test positive ↔
        ∃ path ∈ routes top test positive (syntaxBudget r s.terms) s,
          RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive path)

def FullActualPaidSignedRouteReplay : Prop :=
  ExactSignCutoffFromSyntax ∧ ExactActualReplayContext ∧ ExactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay

namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection MixedSameRankResidue
open ActualMixedRowLeadingSum ActualReadChargeIteration ActualFiniteGlobalTail
open ActualZeroClassCommonTail ActualTraceSignCutoff ActualZeroEdgeConstantShift
open ActualZeroEdgeAlphabet ActualZeroEdgeAlphabetCode ActualSyntaxChargeBudget

def correctionMaxCode (alphabet : AlphabetCode) : Nat :=
  finiteMax correctionBoundCode alphabet

def shortLengthCode (op : LowerOperandCode) : Nat :=
  if op.1 = 2 then shortGapLengthCode op.2.2.2.2.1 op.2.2.2.2.2 else 0

def prefixShortMaxCode (alphabet : AlphabetCode) : Nat :=
  finiteMax (fun p : PrefixCode => shortGapLengthCode p.2.1 p.2.2) (prefixChoicesCode alphabet)

def cleanupMaxCode (alphabet : AlphabetCode) : Nat :=
  finiteMax shortLengthCode (expandCode alphabet)

def edgeFactorCode (alphabet : AlphabetCode) : Nat :=
  correctionMaxCode alphabet + prefixShortMaxCode alphabet + 3 * cleanupMaxCode alphabet

def syntaxMass (terms : List WeightedOperand) : Nat :=
  terms.foldr (fun t rest => t.1.natAbs + rest) 0

def syntaxMassCode (terms : List WeightedCode) : Nat :=
  terms.foldr (fun t rest => t.1.natAbs + rest) 0

noncomputable def depthAlphabet (budget : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List LowerOperand :=
  (List.range (budget+1)).flatMap (fun depth => expandSteps depth (terms.map Prod.snd))

noncomputable def signCeilingAtBudget (budget : Nat) (c : Int) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : Nat :=
  let alphabet := depthAlphabet budget terms
  let mass := 3 ^ budget * syntaxMass terms
  let constant := c.natAbs + budget * (mass * edgeFactor alphabet)
  SelectedLeadingSignCutoff.cutoff (2 * mass) (constant + mass * correctionMaximum alphabet)

/-- Supplied-depth raw calculation. One extra expansion in edgeFactorCode
covers cleaned-away short keys. The initial signed constant is retained. -/
def signCeilingAtBudgetCode (budget : Nat) (c : Int) (terms : List WeightedCode) : Nat :=
  let alphabet := collectCode budget (terms.map Prod.snd)
  let mass := 3 ^ budget * syntaxMassCode terms
  let constant := c.natAbs + budget * (mass * edgeFactorCode alphabet)
  SelectedLeadingSignCutoff.cutoff (2 * mass) (constant + mass * correctionMaxCode alphabet)

def inputSignBoundCode (r : Nat) (c : Int) (terms : List WeightedCode) : Nat :=
  signCeilingAtBudgetCode (syntaxBudgetCode r terms) c terms

def CodeEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec (fun p : Nat × Int × List WeightedCode => signCeilingAtBudgetCode p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
  Primrec (fun p : Nat × Int × List WeightedCode => inputSignBoundCode p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

def CodeCalibration : Prop :=
  (∀ (budget : Nat) (c : Int) (terms : List WeightedOperand),
    signCeilingAtBudgetCode budget c (terms.map encodeWeighted) = signCeilingAtBudget budget c terms) ∧
  ∀ (r : Nat) (c : Int) (terms : List WeightedOperand),
    inputSignBoundCode r c (terms.map encodeWeighted) = signCeilingAtBudget (syntaxBudget r terms) c terms

/-- Inequality, not equality with the exact-charge #949 uniform cutoff. -/
def ExactSignBoundDominance : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    terminalCutoffCeiling r initial ≤
      inputSignBoundCode r initial.constant ((syntaxOf initial).map encodeWeighted)

def FullActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound : Prop :=
  CodeEffectivity ∧ CodeCalibration ∧ ExactSignBoundDominance

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound

def operandCode (p : Pattern) (op : LowerOperandCode) : LowerOperandCode :=
  (op.1,rankCode (p,op.2.1),op.2.2)

def termCode (p : Pattern) (t : WeightedCode) : WeightedCode :=
  (t.1,operandCode p t.2)

def rowCode (p : Pattern) (r : RawRow) : RawRow :=
  (r.1,r.2.1,r.2.2.map (termCode p))

def bitCode (p : Pattern) (r : RawBitRow) : RawBitRow := (rowCode p r.1,r.2)

def familyCode (p : Pattern × RawFamily) : RawFamily := p.2.map (List.map (bitCode p.1))

/-- Full payload with only the affected coordinate erased. This keeps
the test, finite modulus, constant, signed coefficient, operand tag,
ordinal/iterate payload and intended bit in their own literal order. -/
def metadata (r : RawBitRow) : TestCode × Int × List (Int × Nat × LongFieldCode) × Bool :=
  (r.1.1,r.1.2.1,r.1.2.2.map (fun t => (t.1,t.2.1,t.2.2.2)),r.2)

def ExactRawRankCalibration : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Pattern) (family : Family),
    familyCode (p,encodeFamily family) = encodeFamily (ranked p family)

def ExactRawRankLiteralShape : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Pattern) (raw : RawFamily),
    (familyCode (p,raw)).map (List.map metadata) = raw.map (List.map metadata) ∧
    occurrences (familyCode (p,raw)) = (occurrences raw).map (rename p)

def ExactRawRankEffectivity : Prop := Primrec rankCode ∧ Primrec familyCode

def FullActualBitFamilyRawRank : Prop :=
  ExactRawRankCalibration ∧ ExactRawRankLiteralShape ∧ ExactRawRankEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyRawRank

public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankedNormalizationSyntaxTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLowerRankChartRows
open HeterogeneousSignedMatrixSlice (Row)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow ClauseHolds)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (LowerStrict)

def fundRow (B i : Nat) : BitRow := ((.nonnegative,-(B : Int),[(1,.coordinate i)]),true)

def risingRow (i : Nat) : BitRow :=
  ((.positive,0,[(1,.coordinate (i+1)),(-1,.coordinate i)]),true)

/-- Every constraint is a positive linear row on the unchanged genuine
lower raw ranks. Top=0 produces no row or phantom preceding coordinate. -/
def lowerChart (B top : Nat) : List BitRow :=
  ((List.range top).map (fundRow B)) ++ ((List.range (top-1)).map risingRow)

def LowerChartCondition (B top : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ i < top, B ≤ ρ i) ∧ LowerStrict ρ top

def ExactLowerRankChartRows : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (B top : Nat),
    (ClauseHolds f ρ (lowerChart B top) ↔ LowerChartCondition B top ρ) ∧
    ∀ row ∈ lowerChart B top, row.2 = true ∧ ∀ t ∈ row.1.2.2, t.2.rank < top

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLowerRankChartRows

theorem renameIndex (names : List Nat) (p : Pattern) (good : Valid names p)
    (k : Nat) (used : k ∈ names) : rename p k < p.1 := by

  rw [← keys] at used

  rw [consistentRename p good.2.2 e member]

private theorem scopeNamed (family : Family) (names : List Nat) (p : Pattern)

  obtain ⟨source,atSource,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
  obtain ⟨row,atRow,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp inRow
  obtain ⟨raw,atRaw,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp inTerm

    ((support.2 _).mpr (sourceCoordinate family source atSource row atRow raw atRaw))
  rcases raw with ⟨w,op⟩
  cases op <;> exact bound

private theorem foldMaximum {α : Type} (cost : α → Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ xs) :
    cost x ≤ xs.foldr (fun a n => max (cost a) n) 0 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => cases h

  have sourceScope := scopeNamed family names p supports valid

    exact max_le (static.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high)
