module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLowerRankChartRowsTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedRankedLiteralHighTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankChartPrototype
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern patterns guard rename realized)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor)
open OriginalPrintedCircuitSequential (Gate)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixInfiniteLow (matrix)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixOrderBranches (branches)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top replay)
open OriginalPrintedRankedLiteralHigh (cutoff PaidSupport chartMinimum)
open OriginalMatrixDenseRanks (support)

/-- Dense syntax may enumerate inconsistent duplicate names.
A genuine chart labels a literal source name only once. -/
def Consistent (branch : Pattern) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ branch.2, ∀ b ∈ branch.2, a.1 = b.1 → a.2 = b.2

def readWithin (names : List Nat) (branch : Pattern) (lower outside : Nat → Nat)
    (z name : Nat) : Nat :=
  if name ∈ names then Function.update lower (top branch) z (rename branch name) else outside name

def seed (C : Nat) (branch : Pattern) (lower : Nat → Nat) : Nat :=
  max C (rankedPredecessor (top branch) lower)

def prototype (C : Nat) (names : List Nat) (branch : Pattern) (lower outside : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  readWithin names branch lower outside (seed C branch lower)

def ExactChartConsistency : Prop :=
  ∀ (θ : Nat → Nat) (branch : Pattern), (guard branch).eval θ → Consistent branch

def ExactPrototypeChart : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Nat) (names : List Nat) (branch : Pattern), branch ∈ patterns names →
    0 < branch.1 → Consistent branch →
    ∀ (lower outside : Nat → Nat), LowerChartCondition C (top branch) lower →
      let θ := prototype C names branch lower outside
      (guard branch).eval θ ∧ (∀ name ∈ names, C ≤ θ name) ∧
      (∀ i ≤ top branch, realized θ branch i = Function.update lower (top branch) (seed C branch lower) i)

def ExactOriginalChartPrototype : Prop :=
  ∀ (B : Nat) (known : List Nat) (gates : List Gate) (p : NormalForm.Formula)
    (positive : Bool) (branch : Pattern), branch ∈ branches known gates p →
      0 < branch.1 → Consistent branch →
      ∀ (lower outside : Nat → Nat), LowerChartCondition (cutoff B known gates p positive) (top branch) lower →
        let names := support (matrix known gates p)
        let C := cutoff B known gates p positive
        let θ := prototype C names branch lower outside
        (guard branch).eval θ ∧ PaidSupport B θ known gates p positive ∧
        chartMinimum B θ known gates p positive branch = seed C branch lower ∧
        (∀ i < top branch, realized θ branch i = lower i) ∧
        ∀ z : Nat, replay θ known gates p branch z = readWithin names branch lower outside z

def FullActualRankChartPrototype : Prop :=
  ExactChartConsistency ∧ ExactPrototypeChart ∧ ExactOriginalChartPrototype

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankChartPrototype

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridgeTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridgeReadProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualInitialSignedCountCleanupProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidOrderedSyntaxReadsProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection
open SignedRowSliceValue (valueAt)
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand properOperand)
open ActualInitialSignedCountCleanup (cleanup exactOriginalInitialCleanupTest)
open ActualPaidOrderedSyntaxReads (PaidReadCeiling exactPaidOrderedSyntaxReads)
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (SourceHolds)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)

theorem properClauseMember (family : List (List OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses.BitRow))
    (clause : List OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses.BitRow) :
    clause ∈ properClauses family ↔ clause ∈ family ∧ AdmittedLiteralClause clause := by
  simp only [properClauses,List.mem_filter,decide_eq_true_eq]

private theorem sourceVal (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    (∃ v : Int, valueAt f ρ s.constant s.terms v ∧ test.test.atPolarity positive v) ↔
      SourceHolds f ρ s test positive := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,value,bit⟩
    obtain ⟨original,frames,live,eq⟩ := (exactActualRowReadState f ρ s.constant s.terms v).mp value
    have η : SyntaxState.mk s.constant s.terms = s := by cases s; rfl
    exact ⟨original,frames.trans η,live,eq.symm ▸ bit⟩
  · rintro ⟨original,frames,live,bit⟩
    have η : s = SyntaxState.mk s.constant s.terms := by cases s; rfl
    exact ⟨_,(exactActualRowReadState f ρ s.constant s.terms _).mpr
      ⟨original,frames.trans η,live,rfl⟩,bit⟩

private theorem signedCleanup (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (selected : SelectedWithThreshold f B)
    (ρ : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (proper : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, properOperand t.2) (paid : PaidReadCeiling ρ s.terms) :
    (∃ v : Int, valueAt f ρ s.constant s.terms v ∧ test.test.atPolarity positive v) ↔
      SourceHolds f ρ (cleanup s) test positive :=
  (sourceVal f ρ s test positive).trans
    (exactOriginalInitialCleanupTest f B selected ρ s
      (exactPaidOrderedSyntaxReads f B selected ρ s proper paid) test positive)

theorem exactLiteralMixedRowBridge : ExactLiteralMixedRowBridge := by
  intro f B selected ρ row shape paid
  rcases row with ⟨⟨test,c,ts⟩,positive⟩
  let s : SyntaxState := ⟨c,ts⟩
  have ready : ∀ t ∈ s.terms, properOperand t.2 := shape.2
  cases test with
  | equalZero =>
    exact (show (True ∧ _) ↔ _ from ⟨And.right,fun h => ⟨True.intro,h⟩⟩).trans
      (signedCleanup f B selected ρ s .equalZero positive ready paid)
  | nonnegative =>
    exact (show (True ∧ _) ↔ _ from ⟨And.right,fun h => ⟨True.intro,h⟩⟩).trans
      (signedCleanup f B selected ρ s .nonnegative positive ready paid)
  | positive =>
    exact (show (True ∧ _) ↔ _ from ⟨And.right,fun h => ⟨True.intro,h⟩⟩).trans
      (signedCleanup f B selected ρ s .positive positive ready paid)
  | congruence m =>
    exact ⟨And.right,fun h => ⟨shape.1,h⟩⟩

theorem exactLiteralMixedClauseBridge : ExactLiteralMixedClauseBridge := by
  intro f B selected ρ rows proper paid
  constructor
  · intro literal compiled used
    obtain ⟨original,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    exact (exactLiteralMixedRowBridge f B selected ρ original (proper original member)
      (paid original member)).mp (literal original member)
  · intro compiled original member
    exact (exactLiteralMixedRowBridge f B selected ρ original (proper original member)
      (paid original member)).mpr (compiled (compileRow original) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨original,member,rfl⟩))

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawStageCutoffTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedRawStageQueryTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplier
open OrdinalComparison
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (choices tuplePacket)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (LowerStrict)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow RowHolds)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (properClauses AdmittedOperandRow)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor SourceFamily)
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family Holds reifyFamily)
open ActualBitFamilyLowSlices (coordinates dimension)
open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked AllPaid)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (Supplied Valid charts)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern)
open ActualRankChartPrototype (readWithin seed)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (Residual lowerFamily)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeBitRow encodeFamily)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (rowBound familyBound)
open ActualRawStageCutoff (stageBound)
open ActualBitFamilyRawDriver (HighProgram)
open ActualBitFamilyRawSemanticDriver (TypedHigh)
open OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery (HighAtStage)

/-- A per-row packet supplier: at width `r` and greatest rank `top`, one
literal bit row receives a finite list of alternative prepared packets.
Nothing is assumed about how the list is produced or ordered. -/
abbrev Supplier := Nat → Nat → BitRow → List Packet

def SupplierShape (alt : Supplier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (row : BitRow), ∀ q ∈ alt r top row, Shape q

/-- Both directions for one admitted row at one greatest value `z` and one
strict lower valuation. The payments offered to the supplier are exactly
those the executable stage bound provides: every lower rank and `z` meet
the row's own raw majorant `rowBound`, and `z` exceeds the preceding rank.
The supplier owes: the literal row holds at the updated valuation iff one
of its packets holds at that same `z` with its own tied lower table. -/
def SupplierExact (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (alt : Supplier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (row : BitRow) (z : Nat),
    AdmittedOperandRow row →
    LowerStrict baseline top →
    (∀ t ∈ row.1.2.2, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top) →
    (∀ i < top, rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) ≤ baseline i) →
    max (rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)) (rankedPredecessor top baseline) ≤ z →
    (RowHolds f (Function.update baseline top z) row ↔
      ∃ q ∈ alt r top row, PacketHolds f baseline top z q)

/-- One packet per proper clause and per Cartesian choice of one supplied
alternative for every row of that clause, joined in literal row order. -/
noncomputable def packets (alt : Supplier) (r top : Nat) (family : Family) : List Packet :=
  (properClauses family).flatMap
    (fun rows => (choices (rows.map (alt r top))).map tuplePacket)

noncomputable def outputs (alt : Supplier) (C : Nat) (family : Family) (p : Pattern) :
    List Residual :=
  lowerFamily (top p) C ((packets alt p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)).map (prepend (top p)))

noncomputable def child (alt : Supplier) (C : Nat) (family : Family) (p : Pattern) : Family :=
  reifyFamily C (top p) (outputs alt C family p)

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFullLabelPairGuardsTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPreparedSlotAppendTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteFullValueGuards
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open ActualFullValueLabels (Label)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Pair Answer choices cost Ready PaidUpdate ActualOutcome packet)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet append)

def pairs (ls : List Label) : List Pair := ls.flatMap fun l => ls.map (fun r => (l,r))

/-- Literal pair occurrences are kept in lexicographic list-position
order. Inconsistent candidate answers are allowed syntactically, but
cannot satisfy the exact positive conjunction. -/
def patterns : Nat → List (List Answer)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => choices.flatMap (fun a => (patterns n).map (List.cons a))

def compile (top : Nat) : List Pair → List Answer → Packet
  | [],[] => ([],.truth)
  | p::ps,a::as => append (packet top p a) (compile top ps as)
  | _,_ => ([],.falsity)

def familyCost (B : Nat) (ls : List Label) : Nat :=
  (pairs ls).foldr (fun p n => max (cost B p) n) 0

def ReadyFamily (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (ls : List Label) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ls, l.rank ≤ top ∧ ProperField l.field) ∧
  ∀ l ∈ ls, l.rank < top → familyCost B ls ≤ ρ l.rank

def PaidFamily (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (ls : List Label) : Prop :=
  familyCost B ls ≤ z ∧ ∀ l ∈ ls, l.rank < top → ρ l.rank < z

def Matches (f θ : Nat → Nat) (ps : List Pair) (as : List Answer) : Prop :=
  List.Forall₂ (ActualOutcome f θ) ps as

def ExactFinitePatternEnumeration : Prop :=
  ∀ n : Nat, ∀ as : List Answer, as ∈ patterns n ↔ as.length = n

def ExactOrderedGuardFold : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (ps : List Pair) (as : List Answer),
    as.length = ps.length →
    (∀ p ∈ ps, Ready B ρ top p) →
    let q := compile top ps as
    PreparedInput q.1 q.2 ∧
    (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν) ∧
    ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν →
      ∀ z : Nat, (∀ p ∈ ps, PaidUpdate B ρ top z p) →
        (q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔ Matches f (Function.update ρ top z) ps as)

def ExactFiniteFullValueGuards : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (ls : List Label), ReadyFamily B ρ top ls →
    (∀ as ∈ patterns (pairs ls).length,
      let q := compile top (pairs ls) as
      PreparedInput q.1 q.2 ∧
      (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν) ∧
      ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν →
        ∀ z : Nat, PaidFamily B ρ top z ls →
          (q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔ Matches f (Function.update ρ top z) (pairs ls) as)) ∧
    ∀ z : Nat, PaidFamily B ρ top z ls →
      ∃ as ∈ patterns (pairs ls).length,
        Matches f (Function.update ρ top z) (pairs ls) as ∧
        ∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top ρ (compile top (pairs ls) as).1 ν ∧
          ((compile top (pairs ls) as).2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z))

def FullActualFiniteFullValueGuards : Prop :=
  ExactFinitePatternEnumeration ∧ ExactOrderedGuardFold ∧ ExactFiniteFullValueGuards

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteFullValueGuards

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessorTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualReadChargeIterationTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalZeroTrace
open scoped Classical
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection MixedSameRankResidue
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState ActiveAt NodeGuards RankBound stateValue stateCharge)
open ActualFullValueLabels ActualFullLabelPairGuards ActualFiniteFullValueGuards
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations
open ActualZeroClassReplacement ActualZeroClassCohortTransfer ActualZeroClassRecombinedRow
open ActualCountOriginDispositions ActualZeroClassSelectedCountKeys ActualZeroClassConcreteAssembly
open ActualZeroClassGroupedMovedCount (AnchorAt)
open ActualRankedRowColumns ActualZeroClassOutputState ActualShortCountCleanup
open ActualShortCountCleanupCharge InnerTerminationTargets

def eraseState (s : ReadState) : SyntaxState := ⟨s.constant,s.reads.map Prod.fst⟩

/-- Exact actual source conditions for one selected canonical zero step.
They do not assert any progress, chosen output or symbolic replay. -/
structure PreparedStep (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat)
    (s : ReadState) (xs : List Read) (anns : List Annotation) (C : Nat) (a : List Answer) : Prop where
  live : liftedReads f ρ s.reads
  ranks : RankBound r top s
  grouped : normalizeCanonical f ρ s.reads = some xs
  active : ActiveAt top xs
  guards : NodeGuards B ρ xs
  aligned : AlignedAnnotations f ρ (xs.map Prod.fst) (xs.map Prod.snd) anns
  nonempty : labels (xs.map Prod.fst) ≠ []
  matched : Matches f ρ (pairs (labels (xs.map Prod.fst))) a
  maximum : (fullValues f anns).max? = some C
  leadingFloor : f (ρ top) ≤ C
  zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped (s.reads.map Prod.fst)) a = 0
  ready : Ready f B ρ C (xs.map Prod.fst) anns
  transfer : TransferReady B ρ (cohort f C (xs.map Prod.fst) anns)

/-- Same actual ordered zero construction, exact semantic out fields.
No syntax equation is included as a premise of this witness. -/
def CanonicalZeroWitness (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat)
    (s t : ReadState) (a : List Answer) : Prop :=
  ∃ (xs : List Read) (anns : List Annotation) (C : Nat)
    (moved : List Read) (ledger : List DispositionEntry) (x₀ : Fin r) (q : NONote × NONote),
    PreparedStep f B ρ r top s xs anns C a ∧
    let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
    let vals := xs.map Prod.snd
    let ps := cohort f C terms anns
    let anchor := leastPrefix ps
    MovedAt f ρ anchor ps moved ∧ liftedReads f ρ moved ∧ AnchorAt anchor x₀ q ∧
    DisposedOrigins f ρ anchor (countOrigins f C xs anns) ledger moved ∧
    ConcreteEquations f C r s.constant s.reads xs anns x₀ q ledger moved ∧
    let before := outsideCohort f C terms vals anns ++ moved
    let installed := s.constant + (replaceRow f C terms vals anns).2
    ZeroClassReplacement (rankedRow r s.constant s.reads) (rankedRow r installed before) ∧
    CleanedOutput f ρ r s.constant s.reads installed before ∧
    t.constant = installed + shortShift before ∧ t.reads = retained before

inductive CanonicalTrace (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) :
    List (List Answer) → ReadState → ReadState → Prop
  | nil (s : ReadState) : CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top [] s s
  | cons {a : List Answer} {answers : List (List Answer)} {s t u : ReadState} :
      CanonicalZeroWitness f B ρ r top s t a →
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers t u →
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top (a::answers) s u

/-- Purely symbolic replay of the chosen comparison sequence only.
Absence of a successor is retained as failure. -/
noncomputable def replay : List (List Answer) → SyntaxState → Option SyntaxState
  | [],s => some s
  | a::answers,s => do
    let t ← canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a
    replay answers t

def ExactCanonicalZeroWitness : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (s : ReadState) (xs : List Read) (anns : List Annotation) (C : Nat) (a : List Answer),
    PreparedStep f B ρ r top s xs anns C a →
    ∃ t, CanonicalZeroWitness f B ρ r top s t a

def ExactCanonicalZeroReplay : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (s t : ReadState) (a : List Answer),
    CanonicalZeroWitness f B ρ r top s t a →
    canonicalSuccessor s.constant (eraseState s).terms a = some (eraseState t) ∧
    liftedReads f ρ t.reads ∧ RankBound r top t ∧ OriginalRanks s.reads t.reads ∧
    stateValue s = stateValue t ∧ stateCharge r t < stateCharge r s

def ExactCanonicalTraceReplay : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (s t : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers s t →
    replay answers (eraseState s) = some (eraseState t) ∧

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalNodeProgressTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalStoppingTrace
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState RankBound ActiveAt NodeGuards stateValue stateCharge)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping ActualCanonicalZeroTrace
open ActualCanonicalNodeProgress (ProgressAt)
open ActualZeroClassReplacement ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations ActualMixedRowLeadingSum
open ActualFullValueLabels ActualFullLabelPairGuards ActualFiniteFullValueGuards ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling
open ActualZeroClassOutputState (OriginalRanks)
open ActualZeroClassCohortTransfer

/-- Actual nonzero candidate at the selected own-order maximum. This
retains source value identity but does not turn nonzero into a sign. -/
def NonzeroStop (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat)
    (s : ReadState) (xs : List Read) : Prop :=
  let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
  let vals := xs.map Prod.snd
  ∃ (a : List Answer) (anns : List Annotation) (C : Nat) (ν : Nat → Nat),
    a ∈ patterns (pairs (labels terms)).length ∧
    Matches f ρ (pairs (labels terms)) a ∧
    (let packet := compile top (pairs (labels terms)) a
     PreparedTableTied f top ρ packet.1 ν ∧ packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 (ρ top))) ∧
    AlignedAnnotations f ρ terms vals anns ∧
    (fullValues f anns).max? = some C ∧ f (ρ top) ≤ C ∧
    NodeGuards B ρ xs ∧ Ready f B ρ C terms anns ∧ TransferReady B ρ (cohort f C terms anns) ∧
    maximalCoefficient terms a = (rowParts f C terms vals anns).1 ∧
    maximalCoefficient terms a ≠ 0 ∧
    2 * stateValue s = maximalCoefficient terms a * (C : Int) +
      2 * (s.constant + (rowParts f C terms vals anns).2)

def StopsAt (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (s : ReadState) : Prop :=
  ∃ xs, normalizeCanonical f ρ s.reads = some xs ∧ liftedReads f ρ xs ∧
    (¬ ActiveAt top xs ∨ (ActiveAt top xs ∧ NonzeroStop f B ρ r top s xs))

/-- Keep exactly the ordered raw answer-vector codes of the actual trace. -/
def encodeAnswers (answers : List (List Answer)) : List (List Nat) :=
  answers.map (List.map Answer.code)

def ExactCanonicalProgressSplit : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (s : ReadState),
    ProgressAt f B ρ r top s →
    StopsAt f B ρ r top s ∨ ∃ (a : List Answer) (out : ReadState),
      CanonicalZeroWitness f B ρ r top s out a ∧ stateCharge r out < stateCharge r s

/-- Generic over the progress supply at each genuinely reached prefix,
but fixed to the true dependent canonical zero witness, not an arbitrary
decreasing relation. -/
def ExactCanonicalStrictStopping : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    (∀ (seen : List (List Answer)) (s : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top seen initial s → ProgressAt f B ρ r top s) →
    ∃ (answers : List (List Answer)) (stopped : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial stopped ∧ StopsAt f B ρ r top stopped

def ExactFundedCanonicalStoppingTrace : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → RankBound r top initial → LongState initial →
    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) → PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
    ∃ (answers : List (List Answer)) (rawAnswers : List (List Nat)) (stopped : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial stopped ∧ StopsAt f B ρ r top stopped ∧
      rawAnswers = encodeAnswers answers ∧
      replay answers (eraseState initial) = some (eraseState stopped) ∧
      liftedReads f ρ stopped.reads ∧ RankBound r top stopped ∧ LongState stopped ∧
      OriginalRanks initial.reads stopped.reads ∧
      stateValue initial = stateValue stopped ∧
      rawAnswers.length + stateCharge r stopped ≤ stateCharge r initial

def FullActualCanonicalStoppingTrace : Prop :=
  ExactCanonicalProgressSplit ∧ ExactCanonicalStrictStopping ∧ ExactFundedCanonicalStoppingTrace

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalStoppingTrace

# Fable-2 plan — Paper 17, from the supporting results to the high callback contract

Written 2026-11-22 after reading the targets and proofs, not only the notes. Module names are under
`LogicLineages/PermittedControl/`; `X.y` means declaration `y` in namespace
`LogicLineages.PermittedControl.X`.

## Where the gap actually is

The decision theorem is `OriginalPrintedRawSelectedStageQuery.ForControl` (#1372): for every
`high : HighProgram` and `children : TypedHigh` with `OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery.HighAtStage f B
high children`, the raw query is correct, and it is computable when `high` is. So what is owed is

    ∃ high children, HighAtStage f B high children ∧ Computable high.

`HighAtStage` has three clauses per family `fs` of positive dimension, at `C = stageBound B
(encodeFamily fs)`: (1) `high (C, encodeFamily fs) = (children fs).map encodeFamily`; (2) every child
has smaller dimension; (3) `(∃ ρ, AllPaid C fs ρ ∧ Holds f ρ fs) ↔ ∃ ch ∈ children fs, Satisfiable f ch`.

Two things already exist and are easy to overlook:

- A typed, noncomputable compiler with clauses (2) and (3) at any `C ≥ cutoff`:
  `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile`, `exactAboveHighExistential`, `exactAboveHighDimension`
  (#1309), and `ActualRawStageCutoff.exactRawStageCutoffMajorant` (#1336) gives `cutoff ≤ stageBound`.
- Its proofs touch the packet list `OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh.highPackets` only through
  `highPacketShape` and `exactRankedLiteralHigh`; everything downstream
  (`ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection.prepend`, `ActualGreatestRouteResidual.lowerFamily`,
  `ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily.reifyFamily`, `ActualLowerRankChartRows.lowerChart`, the chart
  enumeration) is already generic in a `List Packet`.

So the semantic contract is not missing for the *old* list. What is missing is a list an executable
program can emit. The old one cannot be: `ActualBoundedSignedRoutes.routes` runs on
`normalizedTerms` / `nodePattern` / `successor`, whose order is the legacy `Finset` order (the
"old incidental syntax order" of the handoff). The canonical first-occurrence machinery (#1318–#1384)
is executable (`ActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixes.prefixes`, `stepCode`, `candidateTapes`), but has only
one direction and no emitted guards.

A second, quieter gap: the canonical results are funded by `inputSignBoundCode ≤ ρ top`
(`ActualCanonicalFundedTerminal`), which is *larger* than the legacy
`terminalCutoffCeiling` (`ActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound.ExactSignBoundDominance` is an inequality
in that direction). The typed cutoff `ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh.cutoff` therefore does not obviously
fund the canonical route; the raw `stageBound` does, because `ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling.rowBound`
contains `staticCode = max commonCode signCode`. Any interface for the new compiler has to offer the
raw majorant, not the typed need.

## The chain

**S1 — generic contract over a per-row packet supplier (handoff items (b) and (c)).**
For any `alt : Nat → Nat → BitRow → List Packet` with shaped packets and row-level exactness under
the payments the stage bound provides (`SupplierExact`), the compiler built from `alt` by
Cartesian choice per proper clause, predecessor guard, projection at the shared greatest value,
decoding and reification satisfies clauses (2) and (3) of `HighAtStage` at `stageBound`, and hence
`HighAtStage` for every `high` meeting the literal emission equation.
Module `StageCallbackSupplierTargets` (`ExactSuppliedStageCallback` and five supporting targets).
Uses: `ActualSignedRouteCartesian.exactCartesianPacketEval` (one shared `z`, one tied table per
tuple), `OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge.exactLiteralProperClauseFilter` / `properClauseMember`,
`ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection.exactSymbolicPredecessorAppend` / `…Projection`,
`ActualGreatestRouteResidual.exactActualLowerRouteFamily`,
`ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily.exactGuardedResidualUnion`,
`ActualLowerRankChartRows.exactLowerRankChartRows`, `ActualBitFamilyHigh.exactGenericRankTransport` /
`sourceCoordinate`, `ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh.exactNamedCharts` / `renameIndex` / `checkedLength`,
`ActualFiniteOrderBranches.exactActualBranchCoverage` / `exactPatternEnumeration` /
`exactBranchRealization`, `ActualRankChartPrototype.exactChartConsistency`,
`ActualRawStageCutoff.exactRawStageNamesAndCharts`, `ActualBitFamilyRawRank.exactRawRankCalibration`.
No selection hypothesis is needed in S1 itself; `SupplierExact f B alt` carries all of it.
**Attempt first.**

**S2 — the interface is inhabited and loses nothing.** The legacy
`fun r top row => ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples.alternatives r top (compileRow row)` is a shaped exact
supplier for every selected control, its packet list is literally `highPackets`, and its compile is
literally `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile`. Module `StageCallbackLegacyTargets`.
Uses `ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples.alternativesShape` / `exactPaidMixedRow` / `exactMixedMatrixMinimum`,
`OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge.exactLiteralMixedRowBridge`,
`OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh.exactOriginalLiteralReady` on the one-row family,
`ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling.exactRowBound`. This is a check on S1's hypotheses (that they are not
too strong to meet), not progress toward computability. **Attempt second.**

After S1 the remaining work is exactly two obligations, and they are independent:

**S3 — a canonical executable supplier that is exact (handoff item (a)).** Per signed row, the typed
shadow of the raw candidate list: for each `entry ∈ prefixes (syntaxBudgetCode r start.2) start`,
the packet `guards ++ terminal`, where the guard at each step is
`ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.compile top (pairs (labels terms)) a` on the canonical label order and
the terminal is `ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth.canonicalPacket` (inactive) or the constant truth
value of `signedBit test (maximalCoefficient terms a)` (nonzero). Sub-statements, in order:

- S3a *guard exactness on the canonical order*: under the row payments, `PacketHolds` of the
  compiled guard at `z` iff `Matches f (update baseline top z) (pairs (labels terms)) a`, with a tied
  table always existing. Supplier: `ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.exactFiniteFullValueGuards`
  (already order-parametric in the label list). Missing: `ReadyFamily` / `PaidFamily` for the
  canonical labels of every *reached* state from the row's raw bound — the canonical analogue of
  `ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling.PaidComparisonCeiling`; #1378 has it along one genuine trace.
- S3b *completeness*: a true row has a candidate whose every guard and terminal hold. This is #1384
  (`ActualRawFundedTerminalCandidate.ExactRawFundedTerminalCandidate`) plus S3a at each step of that
  very trace. Needs the valuation `update baseline top z` extended to a `StrictMono` one
  (`ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax.extend`), since the canonical theorems ask `StrictMono ρ`.
- S3c *soundness*: a candidate whose guards all hold is the genuine trace. `Matches` is functional
  in the answer tape (each `ActualOutcome` is a trichotomy), so a holding guard pins the answer to
  the actual one; then `ActualCanonicalZeroTrace.exactCanonicalZeroWitness` and
  `ActualRawCanonicalZeroTraceInclusion.exactActualZeroCandidateEdge` identify the raw step with the
  typed one, and `ActualCanonicalFundedTerminal.exactFundedForwardTruth` gives terminal truth.
  Missing and not yet written anywhere: functionality of `Matches`, and the statement that a
  candidate which *stops* in the raw list (no further step) is at a `StopsAt` node — the raw list
  contains all prefixes, so every proper prefix of a genuine trace is also emitted and must be
  rejected by its terminal; the terminal of a non-stopping prefix has to be falsity, which needs the
  raw node's own active/zero status (`ActualRawCanonicalNode.nodeCode`).
- S3d *congruence rows*: `ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet` and
  `exactGreatestCongruencePacket` already give one exact packet; what is open is whether its
  `layout`/`table` are literal-order (they are `def`, not `noncomputable`, except `packet`) so that
  the raw program can emit it. To check before writing anything.
- S3e *assemble* `SupplierExact f B canonical` from S3a–d, with `rowBound` supplying
  `PaidGlobalTail`, `PaidComparisonCeiling` and `inputSignBoundCode` through
  `ActualRawSignedStaticCeiling` (`commonCode`, `signCode`) and `ActualRawSignedCleanup.cleanupCode`.

**S4 — the emission equation.** A computable `high` with `Emits canonical B high`: raw programs for
`properClauses` (a decidable syntactic filter), `choices`/`tuplePacket`, `prepend`,
`project` (`eliminatePreparedFormula`), `decode`, `reify`/`lowerChart`, the chart enumeration
(`ActualBitFamilyRawCharts.charts` already), and `encodeFamily` of the result. I have not yet checked
which of `project`/`decode` already have a raw computable form; `lowerFamily` and `decodeRoute` are
marked `noncomputable`. This is the part most likely to hide a second "legacy order" problem and
should be surveyed before S3 is finished, so that S3's packet syntax is one S4 can emit.

**S5 — close.** `∃ high, Computable high ∧ HighAtStage f B high (stageChildren canonical B)` from
S1 + S3e + S4, then `ForControl` gives the closed-block decision statement for both controls.

## Order

S1, then S2 (same turn if the gate allows). Next turn: survey for S4 (cheap, reading only) and S3d,
then S3a. S3c is the mathematically riskiest step; S4 the largest.

## For Opus B (join regression)

The join in S1 is `ActualSignedRouteCartesian.tuplePacket` over `choices`; "one shared greatest
value and one tied lower table" is `exactCartesianPacketEval` at a common `z`, and projection happens
only after the join (`project` is applied to `prepend top (tuplePacket …)` inside `lowerFamily`).
A regression with two rows forcing the greatest coordinate to be `C` and `C+1` should therefore be
stated on `PacketHolds f baseline top z (tuplePacket [p₁,p₂])` being false for every `z`, and then on
`LowerHolds … (project C (tuplePacket [p₁,p₂]))` being false — not on the two projected packets
separately, which are each satisfiable. `ActualLowerRankChartRows.fundRow` shows the row syntax for
"coordinate ≥ B" (`(.nonnegative, -B, [(1, .coordinate i)])`).

`LogicLineages/PermittedControl/`; `X.y` means declaration `y` in namespace

## Where the gap actually is

The decision theorem is `OriginalPrintedRawSelectedStageQuery.ForControl` (#1372): for every
`high : HighProgram` and `children : TypedHigh` with `OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery.HighAtStage f B
high children`, the raw query is correct, and it is computable when `high` is. So what is owed is

`HighAtStage` has three clauses per family `fs` of positive dimension, at `C = stageBound B
(encodeFamily fs)`: (1) `high (C, encodeFamily fs) = (children fs).map encodeFamily`; (2) every child
has smaller dimension; (3) `(∃ ρ, AllPaid C fs ρ ∧ Holds f ρ fs) ↔ ∃ ch ∈ children fs, Satisfiable f ch`.

program can emit. The old one cannot be: `ActualBoundedSignedRoutes.routes` runs on
`normalizedTerms` / `nodePattern` / `successor`, whose order is the legacy `Finset` order (the

open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (choices tuplePacket exactCartesianPacketEval)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (LowerStrict)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow RowHolds ClauseHolds)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (properClauses AdmittedOperandRow AdmittedLiteralClause
  properClauseMember exactLiteralProperClauseFilter)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor SourceFamily)
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeBitRow encodeFamily)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (rowBound clauseBound familyBound)

theorem foldMaximum {α : Type} (cost : α → Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ xs) :
    cost x ≤ xs.foldr (fun a n => max (cost a) n) 0 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons a xs ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with same | rest
    · subst a
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact (ih rest).trans (le_max_right _ _)

/-- A row of a clause of the family is covered by the family's raw majorant. -/
theorem rowBelowFamily (B r : Nat) (family : Family) (rows : List BitRow) (member : rows ∈ family)
    (row : BitRow) (used : row ∈ rows) :
    rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) ≤ familyBound B r (encodeFamily family) := by
  have inner : rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) ≤ clauseBound B r (rows.map encodeBitRow) :=
    foldMaximum (rowBound B r) (rows.map encodeBitRow) (encodeBitRow row)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,used,rfl⟩)
  have outer : clauseBound B r (rows.map encodeBitRow) ≤ familyBound B r (encodeFamily family) :=
    foldMaximum (clauseBound B r) (encodeFamily family) (rows.map encodeBitRow)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨rows,member,rfl⟩)
  exact inner.trans outer

theorem alternativeShapes (alt : Supplier) (shaped : SupplierShape alt) (r top : Nat)
    (rows : List BitRow) : ∀ pack ∈ rows.map (alt r top), ∀ p ∈ pack, Shape p := by
  intro pack inPack p inP
  obtain ⟨row,_,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp inPack
  exact shaped r top row p inP

theorem exactSuppliedPacketShape : ExactSuppliedPacketShape := by
  intro alt shaped r top family q used
  obtain ⟨rows,_,here⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp used
  obtain ⟨tuple,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp here
  exact (exactCartesianPacketEval (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) top 0 (rows.map (alt r top))
    (alternativeShapes alt shaped r top rows)).1 tuple member

theorem exactSuppliedRankedPoint : ExactSuppliedRankedPoint := by
  intro f B alt shaped exact r top baseline family z strict scope lower high
  have rowExact (rows : List BitRow) (member : rows ∈ properClauses family)
      (row : BitRow) (used : row ∈ rows) :
      RowHolds f (Function.update baseline top z) row ↔
        ∃ q ∈ alt r top row, PacketHolds f baseline top z q := by
    obtain ⟨inFamily,admitted⟩ := (properClauseMember family rows).mp member
    have bound := rowBelowFamily B r family rows inFamily row used
    exact exact r top baseline row z (admitted row used) strict (scope rows inFamily row used)
      (fun i below => bound.trans (lower i below))
      (max_le (bound.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high))
  refine (exactLiteralProperClauseFilter f (Function.update baseline top z) family).trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rows,member,live⟩
    have cart := (exactCartesianPacketEval f baseline top z (rows.map (alt r top))
      (alternativeShapes alt shaped r top rows)).2
    have each : ∀ pack ∈ rows.map (alt r top), ∃ p ∈ pack, PacketHolds f baseline top z p := by
      intro pack inPack
      obtain ⟨row,used,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp inPack
      exact (rowExact rows member row used).mp (live row used)
    obtain ⟨tuple,chosen,actual⟩ := cart.mpr each
    exact ⟨tuplePacket tuple,
      List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨rows,member,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨tuple,chosen,rfl⟩⟩,actual⟩
  · rintro ⟨q,used,actual⟩
    obtain ⟨rows,member,rest⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp used
    obtain ⟨tuple,chosen,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp rest
    have cart := (exactCartesianPacketEval f baseline top z (rows.map (alt r top))
      (alternativeShapes alt shaped r top rows)).2
    have all := cart.mp ⟨tuple,chosen,actual⟩
    exact ⟨rows,member,fun row used => (rowExact rows member row used).mpr
      (all (alt r top row) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,used,rfl⟩))⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplier

      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,used,rfl⟩)
  have outer : clauseBound B r (rows.map encodeBitRow) ≤ familyBound B r (encodeFamily family) :=

  exact inner.trans outer

  intro f B alt shaped exact r top baseline family z strict scope lower high

      (max_le (bound.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high))

  · rintro ⟨rows,member,live⟩
    have cart := (exactCartesianPacketEval f baseline top z (rows.map (alt r top))
      (alternativeShapes alt shaped r top rows)).2
    have each : ∀ pack ∈ rows.map (alt r top), ∃ p ∈ pack, PacketHolds f baseline top z p := by

    obtain ⟨tuple,chosen,actual⟩ := cart.mpr each

      (within : seed C p lower ≤ z) :
      (∃ q ∈ packets alt p.1 (top p) (ranked p family), PacketHolds f lower (top p) z q) ↔
      Holds f (readWithin names p lower outside z) family := by
    have same (k : Nat) (used : k ∈ coordinates family) :
        Function.update lower (top p) z (rename p k) = readWithin names p lower outside z k := by
      have named : k ∈ names := (support.2 k).mpr used
      rw [readWithin,if_pos named]

      intro c hc row hr t ht

      (exactGenericRankTransport f (readWithin names p lower outside z)

    obtain ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩ :=
      (residualPacket alt shaped f lower C family p).mp ⟨out,inOut,lowerData⟩

      (residualPacket alt shaped f lower C family p).mpr ⟨z,high,(source ready z high).mpr actual⟩

      (exactSymbolicPredecessorProjection f lower (top p) C q shape).mpr ⟨z,high,passes⟩⟩

theorem exactSuppliedUniformChartChild : ExactSuppliedUniformChartChild := by
  intro f B C alt shaped exact family names support paid p good lower outside
  have chart := (exactLowerRankChartRows f lower C (top p)).1
  have decode := (exactGuardedResidualUnion f lower C (top p) (outputs alt C family p)).2
  have static : familyBound B p.1 (encodeFamily (ranked p family)) ≤ C :=
    paid p ((exactNamedCharts names p).mpr good)
  have sourceScope := namedScope family names p support good
  have source (funded : LowerChartCondition C (top p) lower) (z : Nat)
      (within : seed C p lower ≤ z) :

        Function.update lower (top p) z (rename p k) = readWithin names p lower outside z k := by
      have named : k ∈ names := (support.2 k).mpr used
      rw [readWithin,if_pos named]

      intro c hc row hr t ht
      have h := sourceScope c hc row hr t ht
      exact ⟨h,by change t.2.rank ≤ p.1-1; omega⟩

      (ranked p family) z funded.2 scoped

      (max_le (static.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans within)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans within))
    exact point.symm.trans
      (exactGenericRankTransport f (readWithin names p lower outside z)
        (Function.update lower (top p) z) family p same).symm
  constructor
  · intro hold
    obtain ⟨out,inOut,lowerGuard,lowerData⟩ := decode.mp hold
    have ready := chart.mp lowerGuard
    obtain ⟨z,high,q,used,passes⟩ :=
      (residualPacket alt shaped f lower C family p).mp ⟨out,inOut,lowerData⟩
    exact ⟨ready,z,high,rankReads family names p support good C lower outside ready z high,
      (source ready z high).mp ⟨q,used,passes⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨ready,z,high,_,actual⟩
    obtain ⟨out,member,lowers⟩ :=
      (residualPacket alt shaped f lower C family p).mpr ⟨z,high,(source ready z high).mpr actual⟩
    exact decode.mpr ⟨out,member,chart.mpr ready,lowers⟩

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierPointProof

import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighSetupProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesCoverageProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesEnumerateProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesRealizationProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankChartPrototypeReadProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestRouteResidualProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyLowSlicesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGuardedResidualBitFamilyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLowerRankChartRowsProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawStageCutoffProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyRawRankProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplier
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family Holds exactGuardedResidualUnion)
open ActualBitFamilyLowSlices (coordinates coordinateClause originalRows dimension)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern actualPattern guard realized rename
  exactActualBranchCoverage exactPatternEnumeration exactBranchRealization)
open ActualRankChartPrototype (Consistent exactChartConsistency seed readWithin)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition lowerChart exactLowerRankChartRows)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open OriginalPrintedHighResidual (guardedRows)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (Residual rows exactActualLowerRouteFamily)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend)
open OriginalMatrixLowDimension (supportSet)
open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked AllPaid)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (Valid Supplied charts exactNamedCharts checkedLength)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeFamily)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (familyBound)
open ActualRawStageCutoff (stageBound chartCost exactRawStageNamesAndCharts)
open ActualBitFamilyRawRank (exactRawRankCalibration)
open ActualBitFamilyRawDriver (HighProgram)
open ActualBitFamilyExistentialLow (Satisfiable)
open OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery (HighAtStage)

/-- An all-paid valuation determines its own valid chart, lower table and
greatest value; reading the chart back returns the valuation itself. -/
theorem actualChartValues (family : Family) (names : List Nat) (supports : Supplied family names)
    (p : Pattern) (member : p ∈ ActualFiniteOrderBranches.patterns names)
    (θ : Nat → Nat) (checked : (guard p).eval θ) (nonempty : 0 < dimension family)
    (C : Nat) (paid : AllPaid C family θ) :
    0 < p.1 ∧ LowerChartCondition C (top p) (realized θ p) ∧
      seed C p (realized θ p) ≤ realized θ p (top p) ∧
      readWithin names p (realized θ p) θ (realized θ p (top p)) = θ := by
  let greatest := top p
  let base := realized θ p
  obtain ⟨_,keys,bounds,onto⟩ := (exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp member
  obtain ⟨strict,slots,ties⟩ := exactBranchRealization θ names p member checked
  have width : 0 < p.1 := by
    obtain ⟨n,used⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp nonempty
    have input : n ∈ names := (supports.2 n).mpr used
    exact (Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt (ties n input).1
  have payRank (i : Nat) (used : i < p.1) : C ≤ base i := by
    obtain ⟨e,member,eq⟩ := onto i used
    have n : e.1 ∈ names := by
      rw [← keys]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,member,rfl⟩
    change C ≤ realized θ p i
    rw [← eq,(slots e member).2]
    exact paid e.1 ((supports.2 e.1).mp n)
  have topWidth : greatest < p.1 := by
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  have chart : LowerChartCondition C greatest base :=
    ⟨fun i h => payRank i (h.trans topWidth),fun i j lt _ => strict lt⟩
  have pred : rankedPredecessor greatest base ≤ base greatest := by
    by_cases zero : greatest = 0
    · simp only [rankedPredecessor,if_pos zero,Nat.zero_le]
    · rw [rankedPredecessor,if_neg zero]
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (strict (show greatest-1 < greatest by omega))
  refine ⟨width,chart,max_le (payRank greatest topWidth) pred,?_⟩
  funext n
  by_cases used : n ∈ names
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_pos used]
    change Function.update base greatest (base greatest) (rename p n) = θ n
    rw [Function.update_eq_self]
    exact (ties n used).2
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_neg used]

theorem exactSuppliedHighExistential : ExactSuppliedHighExistential := by
  intro f B C alt shaped exact family names supplied paidRaw nonempty
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ,paid,truth⟩
    let p := actualPattern θ names
    obtain ⟨member,checked⟩ := exactActualBranchCoverage θ names
    obtain ⟨width,lower,high,actual⟩ :=
      actualChartValues family names supplied p member θ checked nonempty C paid
    have good : Valid names p := ⟨member,width,exactChartConsistency θ p checked⟩
    let base := realized θ p
    have rawTruth : Holds f (readWithin names p base θ (base (top p))) family := by
      rw [actual]
      exact truth
    have rawPaid : AllPaid C family (readWithin names p base θ (base (top p))) := by
      rw [actual]
      exact paid
    have childTruth := (exactSuppliedUniformChartChild f B C alt shaped exact family names
      supplied paidRaw p good base θ).mpr ⟨lower,base (top p),high,rawPaid,rawTruth⟩
    exact ⟨(p,child alt C family p),
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,(exactNamedCharts names p).mpr good,rfl⟩,base,childTruth⟩
  · rintro ⟨result,member,lower,truth⟩
    obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
    obtain ⟨_,z,_,paid,source⟩ :=
      (exactSuppliedUniformChartChild f B C alt shaped exact family names supplied paidRaw
        p good lower (fun _ => 0)).mp truth
    exact ⟨readWithin names p lower (fun _ => 0) z,paid,source⟩

theorem guardedBelow (C greatest : Nat) (out : Residual)
    (lower : ∀ k ∈ supportSet (rows out), k < greatest) :
    ∀ k ∈ supportSet (guardedRows C greatest out), k < greatest := by
  intro k used
  obtain ⟨r,member,ranked⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp used)
  rcases List.mem_append.mp member with chart | residual
  · obtain ⟨row,atChart,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp chart
    obtain ⟨term,seen,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ranked
    exact ((exactLowerRankChartRows (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest).2 row atChart).2 term seen
  · exact lower k (List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨r,residual,ranked⟩))

theorem exactSuppliedHighDimension : ExactSuppliedHighDimension := by
  intro alt shaped C family names supplied result member
  obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  let greatest := top p
  let qs := (packets alt p.1 greatest (ranked p family)).map (prepend greatest)
  let childFamily := child alt C family p
  have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
  have width : p.1 ≤ dimension family := by
    have chart := ((exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp good.1).1
    rw [← checkedLength family names supplied]
    exact chart
  have core := (exactActualLowerRouteFamily (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) greatest C qs
    (amendedShapes alt shaped p family)).1
  have source := (exactGuardedResidualUnion (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest
    (outputs alt C family p)).1
  have scope (k : Nat) (inUnion : k ∈ coordinates childFamily) : k < greatest := by
    obtain ⟨clause,member,atClause⟩ := (coordinateClause childFamily k).mp inUnion
    obtain ⟨out,used,exactOut⟩ := source clause member
    change clause.map Prod.fst = guardedRows C greatest out at exactOut
    change k ∈ supportSet (clause.map Prod.fst) at atClause
    rw [exactOut] at atClause
    exact guardedBelow C greatest out (core out used) k atClause
  have subset : coordinates childFamily ⊆ Finset.range greatest :=
    fun k member => Finset.mem_range.mpr (scope k member)
  have bound : dimension childFamily ≤ greatest := by
    simpa only [Finset.card_range] using Finset.card_le_card subset
  have lower : greatest < p.1 := by
    have pos := good.2.1
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  exact ⟨scope,bound.trans_lt (lower.trans_le width)⟩

/-- The executable stage bound covers the raw majorant of every valid
chart's ranked family on the encoded family's own name list. -/
theorem stagePaid (B : Nat) (fs : Family) :
    RawPaid B (stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)) fs
      (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) := by
  intro p listed
  have eq := (exactRawStageNamesAndCharts.2 fs).2
  rw [← eq] at listed
  have cost : chartCost B (encodeFamily fs) p ≤ stageBound B (encodeFamily fs) :=
    foldMaximum (chartCost B (encodeFamily fs)) _ p listed
  have same : chartCost B (encodeFamily fs) p = familyBound B p.1 (encodeFamily (ranked p fs)) := by
    unfold chartCost
    rw [exactRawRankCalibration]
  rw [← same]
  exact cost

theorem exactSuppliedStageCallback : ExactSuppliedStageCallback := by
  intro f B alt shaped exact high emits fs nonzero
  have supplied : Supplied fs (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) :=
    (exactRawStageNamesAndCharts.2 fs).1
  have paid := stagePaid B fs
  refine ⟨emits fs nonzero,?_,?_⟩
  · intro ch member
    obtain ⟨result,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    exact (exactSuppliedHighDimension alt shaped (stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)) fs
      (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) supplied result listed).2
  · refine (exactSuppliedHighExistential f B (stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)) alt shaped exact fs
      (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) supplied paid nonzero).trans ?_
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨result,listed,lower,truth⟩
      exact ⟨result.2,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨result,listed,rfl⟩,lower,truth⟩
    · rintro ⟨ch,member,lower,truth⟩
      obtain ⟨result,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
      exact ⟨result,listed,lower,truth⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplier

public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierPointProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierChartProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNamedBitFamilyHighSetupProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesCoverageProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesEnumerateProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteOrderBranchesRealizationProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankChartPrototypeReadProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestRouteResidualProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyLowSlicesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGuardedResidualBitFamilyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLowerRankChartRowsProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawStageCutoffProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBitFamilyRawRankProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplier
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family Holds exactGuardedResidualUnion)
open ActualBitFamilyLowSlices (coordinates coordinateClause originalRows dimension)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern actualPattern guard realized rename
  exactActualBranchCoverage exactPatternEnumeration exactBranchRealization)
open ActualRankChartPrototype (Consistent exactChartConsistency seed readWithin)
open ActualLowerRankChartRows (LowerChartCondition lowerChart exactLowerRankChartRows)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open OriginalPrintedHighResidual (guardedRows)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (Residual rows exactActualLowerRouteFamily)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend)
open OriginalMatrixLowDimension (supportSet)
open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked AllPaid)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (Valid Supplied charts exactNamedCharts checkedLength)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeFamily)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (familyBound)
open ActualRawStageCutoff (stageBound chartCost exactRawStageNamesAndCharts)
open ActualBitFamilyRawRank (exactRawRankCalibration)
open ActualBitFamilyRawDriver (HighProgram)
open ActualBitFamilyExistentialLow (Satisfiable)
open OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery (HighAtStage)

/-- An all-paid valuation determines its own valid chart, lower table and
greatest value; reading the chart back returns the valuation itself. -/
theorem actualChartValues (family : Family) (names : List Nat) (supports : Supplied family names)
    (p : Pattern) (member : p ∈ ActualFiniteOrderBranches.patterns names)
    (θ : Nat → Nat) (checked : (guard p).eval θ) (nonempty : 0 < dimension family)
    (C : Nat) (paid : AllPaid C family θ) :
    0 < p.1 ∧ LowerChartCondition C (top p) (realized θ p) ∧
      seed C p (realized θ p) ≤ realized θ p (top p) ∧
      readWithin names p (realized θ p) θ (realized θ p (top p)) = θ := by
  let greatest := top p
  let base := realized θ p
  obtain ⟨_,keys,bounds,onto⟩ := (exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp member
  obtain ⟨strict,slots,ties⟩ := exactBranchRealization θ names p member checked
  have width : 0 < p.1 := by
    obtain ⟨n,used⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp nonempty
    have input : n ∈ names := (supports.2 n).mpr used
    exact (Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt (ties n input).1
  have payRank (i : Nat) (used : i < p.1) : C ≤ base i := by
    obtain ⟨e,member,eq⟩ := onto i used
    have n : e.1 ∈ names := by
      rw [← keys]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,member,rfl⟩
    change C ≤ realized θ p i
    rw [← eq,(slots e member).2]
    exact paid e.1 ((supports.2 e.1).mp n)
  have topWidth : greatest < p.1 := by
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  have chart : LowerChartCondition C greatest base :=
    ⟨fun i h => payRank i (h.trans topWidth),fun i j lt _ => strict lt⟩
  have pred : rankedPredecessor greatest base ≤ base greatest := by
    by_cases zero : greatest = 0
    · simp only [rankedPredecessor,if_pos zero,Nat.zero_le]
    · rw [rankedPredecessor,if_neg zero]
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (strict (show greatest-1 < greatest by omega))
  refine ⟨width,chart,max_le (payRank greatest topWidth) pred,?_⟩
  funext n
  by_cases used : n ∈ names
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_pos used]
    change Function.update base greatest (base greatest) (rename p n) = θ n
    rw [Function.update_eq_self]
    exact (ties n used).2
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_neg used]

theorem exactSuppliedHighExistential : ExactSuppliedHighExistential := by
  intro f B C alt shaped exact family names supplied paidRaw nonempty
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ,paid,truth⟩
    let p := actualPattern θ names
    obtain ⟨member,checked⟩ := exactActualBranchCoverage θ names
    obtain ⟨width,lower,high,actual⟩ :=
      actualChartValues family names supplied p member θ checked nonempty C paid
    have good : Valid names p := ⟨member,width,exactChartConsistency θ p checked⟩
    let base := realized θ p
    have rawTruth : Holds f (readWithin names p base θ (base (top p))) family := by
      rw [actual]
      exact truth
    have rawPaid : AllPaid C family (readWithin names p base θ (base (top p))) := by
      rw [actual]
      exact paid
    have childTruth := (exactSuppliedUniformChartChild f B C alt shaped exact family names
      supplied paidRaw p good base θ).mpr ⟨lower,base (top p),high,rawPaid,rawTruth⟩
    exact ⟨(p,child alt C family p),
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,(exactNamedCharts names p).mpr good,rfl⟩,base,childTruth⟩
  · rintro ⟨result,member,lower,truth⟩
    obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
    obtain ⟨_,z,_,paid,source⟩ :=
      (exactSuppliedUniformChartChild f B C alt shaped exact family names supplied paidRaw
        p good lower (fun _ => 0)).mp truth
    exact ⟨readWithin names p lower (fun _ => 0) z,paid,source⟩

theorem guardedBelow (C greatest : Nat) (out : Residual)
    (lower : ∀ k ∈ supportSet (rows out), k < greatest) :
    ∀ k ∈ supportSet (guardedRows C greatest out), k < greatest := by
  intro k used
  obtain ⟨r,member,ranked⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp used)
  rcases List.mem_append.mp member with chart | residual
  · obtain ⟨row,atChart,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp chart
    obtain ⟨term,seen,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ranked
    exact ((exactLowerRankChartRows (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest).2 row atChart).2 term seen
  · exact lower k (List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨r,residual,ranked⟩))

theorem exactSuppliedHighDimension : ExactSuppliedHighDimension := by
  intro alt shaped C family names supplied result member
  obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  let greatest := top p
  let qs := (packets alt p.1 greatest (ranked p family)).map (prepend greatest)
  let childFamily := child alt C family p
  have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
  have width : p.1 ≤ dimension family := by
    have chart := ((exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp good.1).1
    rw [← checkedLength family names supplied]
    exact chart
  have core := (exactActualLowerRouteFamily (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) greatest C qs
    (amendedShapes alt shaped p family)).1
  have source := (exactGuardedResidualUnion (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest
    (outputs alt C family p)).1
  have scope (k : Nat) (inUnion : k ∈ coordinates childFamily) : k < greatest := by
    obtain ⟨clause,member,atClause⟩ := (coordinateClause childFamily k).mp inUnion
    obtain ⟨out,used,exactOut⟩ := source clause member
    change clause.map Prod.fst = guardedRows C greatest out at exactOut
    change k ∈ supportSet (clause.map Prod.fst) at atClause
    rw [exactOut] at atClause
    exact guardedBelow C greatest out (core out used) k atClause
  have subset : coordinates childFamily ⊆ Finset.range greatest :=
    fun k member => Finset.mem_range.mpr (scope k member)
  have bound : dimension childFamily ≤ greatest := by
    simpa only [Finset.card_range] using Finset.card_le_card subset
  have lower : greatest < p.1 := by
    have pos := good.2.1
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  exact ⟨scope,bound.trans_lt (lower.trans_le width)⟩

/-- The executable stage bound covers the raw majorant of every valid
chart's ranked family on the encoded family's own name list. -/
theorem stagePaid (B : Nat) (fs : Family) :
    RawPaid B (stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)) fs
      (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) := by
  intro p listed
  have eq := (exactRawStageNamesAndCharts.2 fs).2
  rw [← eq] at listed
  have cost : chartCost B (encodeFamily fs) p ≤ stageBound B (encodeFamily fs) :=
    foldMaximum (chartCost B (encodeFamily fs)) _ p listed
  have same : chartCost B (encodeFamily fs) p = familyBound B p.1 (encodeFamily (ranked p fs)) := by
    unfold chartCost
    rw [exactRawRankCalibration]
  rw [← same]
  exact cost

theorem exactSuppliedStageCallback : ExactSuppliedStageCallback := by
  intro f B alt shaped exact high emits fs nonzero
  have supplied : Supplied fs (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) :=
    (exactRawStageNamesAndCharts.2 fs).1
  have paid := stagePaid B fs
  refine ⟨emits fs nonzero,?_,?_⟩
  · intro ch member
    obtain ⟨result,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    exact (exactSuppliedHighDimension alt shaped (stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)) fs
      (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) supplied result listed).2
  · refine (exactSuppliedHighExistential f B (stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)) alt shaped exact fs
      (ActualBitFamilyRawLayout.names (encodeFamily fs)) supplied paid nonzero).trans ?_
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨result,listed,lower,truth⟩
      exact ⟨result.2,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨result,listed,rfl⟩,lower,truth⟩
    · rintro ⟨ch,member,lower,truth⟩
      obtain ⟨result,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
      exact ⟨result,listed,lower,truth⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplier

# Paper 17: the high callback contract, generic in the per-row packet list

Key: `STAGE-CALLBACK-SUPPLIER`. Targets module
`LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierTargets`.

Printed source: `17-permitted-control-canonical-comparison/sections/arithmetic.tex`,
`thm:arithmetic`, the paragraph "On the all-large branch … Apply effective Presburger elimination to
∃z, treating all lower-input fields as parameters … The resulting formula is in the same matrix
language on n−1 coordinates." Handoff item: "use the checked Cartesian packet evaluation and
chosen-route projection at one shared greatest value and one tied lower table; reify the guarded
residuals as strictly smaller families of the same encoded type; prove both directions of the high
callback contract at the executable stage bound."

## What is stated

A *supplier* assigns to each literal bit row, at a width and a greatest rank, a finite list of
prepared packets. Two properties are asked of it:

- `SupplierShape`: every packet is a prepared input.
- `SupplierExact f B`: for an admitted row, a strictly ordered lower valuation, row ranks inside the
  chart, every lower rank and the greatest value `z` at least the row's own executable majorant
  `rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)`, and `z` above the preceding rank — the row holds at the updated
  valuation **iff** one of its packets holds at that same `z` with its own tied lower table.

From such a supplier the module builds, with the existing generic operations only, a compiler:
per proper clause the Cartesian choice of one packet per row joined by `tuplePacket`; the symbolic
predecessor guard; projection of the greatest coordinate, decoding, and the lower-chart reification;
one child per valid chart of the family's names.

Targets:

- `ExactSuppliedPacketShape`, `ExactSuppliedRankedPoint` — the joined packets are shaped, and at one
  shared greatest value the ranked family holds iff one joined packet holds.
- `ExactSuppliedUniformChartChild` — a child holds at a lower valuation iff that valuation meets the
  lower chart and some greatest value above the seed gives an all-paid satisfying source valuation.
- `ExactSuppliedHighExistential`, `ExactSuppliedHighDimension` — both directions of "an all-paid
  witness exists iff some child is satisfiable", and every child has strictly smaller dimension.
- `ExactSuppliedStageCallback` — for every exact shaped supplier and every raw program meeting the
  literal emission equation `Emits`, `OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery.HighAtStage f B high
  (stageChildren alt B)` at `stageBound B (encodeFamily fs)` on the executable name list
  `names (encodeFamily fs)`.

## What is assumed

Only the two supplier properties and, for the last target, the emission equation. There is no
hypothesis on `f` or `B` other than through `SupplierExact f B alt`; in particular
`SelectedWithThreshold` is not used by this module. The payments offered to the supplier are the raw
majorant `rowBound`, which is what `stageBound` dominates (through `chartCost` and
`ActualBitFamilyRawRank.familyCode`), not the smaller typed `familyNeed`. This is deliberate: the
canonical route is funded by `inputSignBoundCode`, which `rowBound` contains and the typed cutoff
does not.

## What is not claimed

- No supplier is exhibited here and none is shown computable. (The companion key
  `STAGE-CALLBACK-LEGACY` shows the existing typed alternatives satisfy the interface.)
- No raw high program is constructed; `Emits` is a hypothesis. The compiler `compile` is
  `noncomputable` (it uses `properClauses`, `lowerFamily`, the classical chart filter).
- Nothing about which packets an executable program can emit, about guard rendering, or about the
  canonical candidates. Those are the content of `SupplierExact` for a future supplier.
- No numbered statement is promoted and `thm:arithmetic` is not closed by this.

## Relation to accepted work

The proofs follow `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove{Uniform,Existential,Dimension}Proof` (#1309) and
`OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHighPointProof` step for step, with `highPackets` replaced by the supplied
list and the typed `OriginalSetup`/`highMinimum` payments replaced by the raw majorant. The private
helper lemmas of those modules (`rankReads`, `residualPacket`, `actualChartValues`, `guardedBelow`,
`scopeNamed`, `foldMaximum`) are restated here because they are not exported. No accepted module is
edited.

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacyTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierContractProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuplesRowProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuplesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridgeProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHighReadyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawMixedFamilyCeilingProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacy
open OrdinalComparison
open StageCallbackSupplier (Supplier SupplierShape SupplierExact packets outputs child compile
  stageChildren Emits exactSuppliedStageCallback)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (alternatives tuples alternativesShape exactPaidMixedRow
  exactMixedMatrixMinimum)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (choices tuplePacket)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (compileRow properClauses AdmittedLiteralClause
  properClauseMember exactLiteralMixedRowBridge)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (highPackets familyNeed highMinimum OriginalSetup
  exactOriginalLiteralReady)
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family reifyFamily)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern)
open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (charts)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (lowerFamily)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeBitRow encodeFamily)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (rowBound familyBound exactFamilyBound)

theorem exactLegacySupplierShape : ExactLegacySupplierShape := by
  intro r top row q used
  exact alternativesShape (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) r top 0 (compileRow row) q used

/-- The one-row family's typed need is below that row's raw majorant. -/
theorem singleNeed (B r : Nat) (row : BitRow) :
    familyNeed B r [[row]] ≤ rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) := by
  have raw : familyBound B r (encodeFamily [[row]]) = rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) := by
    show max (max (rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)) 0) 0 = rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)
    rw [Nat.max_zero,Nat.max_zero]
  exact (exactFamilyBound B r [[row]]).trans (le_of_eq raw)

theorem exactLegacySupplierExact : ExactLegacySupplierExact := by
  intro f B selected r top baseline row z admitted strict scope lower high
  have need := singleNeed B r row
  have setup : OriginalSetup B r top baseline [[row]] := by
    refine ⟨strict,?_,?_⟩
    · intro rows inFamily other inRows t inTerms
      have e1 : rows = [row] := List.mem_singleton.mp inFamily
      rw [e1] at inRows
      have e2 : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows
      rw [e2] at inTerms
      exact scope t inTerms
    · intro _ _ _ _ t _ below
      exact need.trans (lower t.2.rank below)
  have payment : highMinimum B r top baseline [[row]] ≤ z :=
    max_le (need.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high)
  have clause : AdmittedLiteralClause [row] := by
    intro other inRows
    have e : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows
    rw [e]
    exact admitted
  have member : [row] ∈ properClauses [[row]] :=
    (properClauseMember [[row]] [row]).mpr ⟨List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,clause⟩
  have ready := exactOriginalLiteralReady B r top baseline [[row]] setup z payment [row] member
  have here : compileRow row ∈ [row].map compileRow :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,rfl⟩
  have minimum := (exactMixedMatrixMinimum B r top baseline ([row].map compileRow) z).mp
    ready.2.2 (compileRow row) here
  have literal := exactLiteralMixedRowBridge f B selected (Function.update baseline top z) row
    admitted (ready.1 row (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl))
  have routed := exactPaidMixedRow f B selected r top baseline (compileRow row)
    (ready.2.1 (compileRow row) here) z minimum
  exact literal.trans routed

theorem legacyPackets (r top : Nat) (family : Family) :
    packets legacy r top family = highPackets r top family := by
  have rowsEq (rows : List BitRow) :
      rows.map (legacy r top) = (rows.map compileRow).map (alternatives r top) := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    rfl
  show (properClauses family).flatMap
      (fun rows => (choices (rows.map (legacy r top))).map tuplePacket) =
    (properClauses family).flatMap
      (fun rows => (choices ((rows.map compileRow).map (alternatives r top))).map tuplePacket)
  simp only [rowsEq]

theorem exactLegacyLiteralCompile : ExactLegacyLiteralCompile := by
  refine ⟨legacyPackets,?_⟩
  intro C family names
  have childEq (p : Pattern) :
      child legacy C family p = ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.child C family p := by
    show reifyFamily C (top p) (lowerFamily (top p) C
        ((packets legacy p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)).map (prepend (top p)))) =
      reifyFamily C (top p) (lowerFamily (top p) C
        ((highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)).map (prepend (top p))))
    rw [legacyPackets]
  show (charts names).map (fun p => (p,child legacy C family p)) =
    (charts names).map (fun p => (p,ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.child C family p))
  simp only [childEq]

theorem exactLegacyStageCallback : ExactLegacyStageCallback := by
  intro f B selected high emits
  exact exactSuppliedStageCallback f B legacy exactLegacySupplierShape
    (exactLegacySupplierExact f B selected) high emits

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacy

theorem exactOriginalLiteralReady : ExactOriginalLiteralReady := by
  intro B r top baseline family setup z high rows member
  obtain ⟨literal,admitted⟩ := (properClauseMember family rows).mp member
  have structural (row : BitRow) (used : row ∈ rows) : rowNeed B r row ≤ familyNeed B r family :=
    (memberBound (rowNeed B r) rows row used).trans (memberBound (clauseNeed B r) _ rows member)
  have upper : familyNeed B r family ≤ z := (le_max_left _ _).trans high
  have previous : rankedPredecessor top baseline ≤ z := (le_max_right _ _).trans high
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro row used t occurs
    have a : readCeiling row.1.2.2 ≤ familyNeed B r family := (le_max_left _ _).trans (structural row used)
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (setup.scope rows literal row used t occurs).2 with lower | here
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_lt lower)]
      exact a.trans (setup.lower rows member row used t occurs lower)
    · rw [here,Function.update_self]
      exact a.trans upper
  · intro found used
    obtain ⟨row,atRow,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    exact paidCompiled B r top baseline row (admitted row atRow) setup.strict
      (setup.scope rows literal row atRow)
      (fun t occurs below => (le_max_right _ _).trans ((structural row atRow).trans
        (setup.lower rows member row atRow t occurs below)))
  · apply (exactMixedMatrixMinimum B r top baseline (rows.map compileRow) z).mpr
    intro found used
    obtain ⟨row,atRow,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    exact compiledMin B r top baseline (compileRow row) z
      ((le_max_right _ _).trans ((structural row atRow).trans upper)) previous

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh

weightedTailCode B m (s.terms.map encodeWeighted) = modulusMinimum B m s :=
  modTape B m s.terms

theorem exactRowBound (B r : Nat) (row : BitRow) :
    rowNeed B r row ≤ rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) := by
  rcases row with ⟨⟨test,c,ts⟩,bit⟩
  let s : SyntaxState := ⟨c,ts⟩
  have read : readCeiling ts ≤ rowCode (encodeRow (test,c,ts)) :=
    le_of_eq (rowCalibration (test,c,ts)).symm
  have hi := exactRawSignedStaticMajorant B r (cleanup s)
  rw [← cleanupCalibration] at hi
  cases test with
  | equalZero => exact max_le_max read hi
  | nonnegative => exact max_le_max read hi
  | positive => exact max_le_max read hi
  | congruence m =>
    have hm : modulusMinimum B m s ≤ weightedTailCode B m (ts.map encodeWeighted) :=
      le_of_eq (modCalibration B m s).symm
    exact max_le_max read hm

theorem exactClauseBound (B r : Nat) (rows : List BitRow) :
    clauseNeed B r rows ≤ clauseBound B r (rows.map encodeBitRow) := by
  induction rows with
  | nil => exact Nat.le_refl _
  | cons row tail ih => exact max_le_max (exactRowBound B r row) ih

/-- Any literal source filter can only omit row costs. This raw bound
does not decide the actual typed proper-clause filter. -/
private theorem anyFilterBound (B r : Nat) (p : List BitRow → Bool) (family : Family) :
    (family.filter p).foldr (fun rows n => max (clauseNeed B r rows) n) 0 ≤
      familyBound B r (encodeFamily family) := by
  induction family with
  | nil => exact Nat.le_refl _
  | cons rows tail ih =>
    change ((rows :: tail).filter p).foldr (fun rs n => max (clauseNeed B r rs) n) 0 ≤
      max (clauseBound B r (rows.map encodeBitRow)) (familyBound B r (encodeFamily tail))
    rw [List.filter_cons]
    split
    · exact max_le_max (exactClauseBound B r rows) ih
    · exact ih.trans (le_max_right _ _)

theorem exactFamilyBound (B r : Nat) (family : Family) :
    familyNeed B r family ≤ familyBound B r (encodeFamily family) := by
  unfold familyNeed properClauses
  exact anyFilterBound B r _ family

theorem exactRawMixedRowMajorants : ExactRawMixedRowMajorants := ⟨modCalibration,exactRowBound⟩
theorem exactRawMixedFamilyMajorants : ExactRawMixedFamilyMajorants := ⟨exactClauseBound,exactFamilyBound⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixPaidCongruenceTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand properOperand encodeWeighted weightedTailCode)
open OriginalMatrixPaidCongruence (Covers paidTerms modular)
open MixedRankResidue (rankSupport)
open SharedRankResidueRow (Layout)
open RankResidueChoices (namedSlots)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (choosePolarity)
open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test)
open SignedRowSliceValue (valueAt)

def lowerRanks (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List Nat :=
  (rankSupport terms).filter (fun rank => decide (rank < top))

/-- The greatest raw coordinate is the only reserved zero name. Original
raw rank zero remains a positive table name if it is genuinely lower. -/
def layout (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : Layout :=
  (0,top) :: namedSlots (lowerRanks top terms)

def table (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List LowerOperand :=
  (lowerRanks top terms).map LowerOperand.coordinate

noncomputable def packet (top m : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
  (table top s.terms, choosePolarity (modular (layout top s.terms) m s.constant s.terms) positive)

def modulusMinimum (B m : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Nat :=
  s.terms.foldr (fun t n => max (weightedTailCode B m [encodeWeighted t]) n) 0

def LowerModulusSetup (B top m : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (s : SyntaxState) : Prop :=
  0 < m ∧ (∀ t ∈ s.terms, t.2.rank ≤ top ∧ properOperand t.2) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ s.terms, t.2.rank < top → modulusMinimum B m s ≤ baseline t.2.rank

def SourceCongruence (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (positive : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ v : Int, valueAt f ρ s.constant s.terms v ∧ (Test.congruence m).atPolarity positive v

def ExactGreatestResidueLayout : Prop :=
  ∀ (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand),
    ((∀ t ∈ terms, t.2.rank ≤ top) → Covers (layout top terms) terms) ∧
    (∀ slot ∈ layout top terms, slot.1 = 0 ↔ slot.2 = top) ∧
    ∀ slot ∈ layout top terms, slot.1 ≤ (table top terms).length

def ExactGreatestResidueTies : Prop :=
  ∀ (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand),
    (∃ ν, PreparedTableTied f top baseline (table top terms) ν) ∧
    ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f top baseline (table top terms) ν →
      ∀ (z : Nat) (slot), slot ∈ layout top terms →
        Function.update ν 0 z slot.1 = Function.update baseline top z slot.2

def ExactGreatestCongruenceShape : Prop :=
  ∀ (top m : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (positive : Bool),
    PreparedInput (packet top m s positive).1 (packet top m s positive).2

def ExactGreatestCongruencePacket : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ (baseline : Nat → Nat) (top m : Nat) (s : SyntaxState), LowerModulusSetup B top m baseline s →
      ∀ (z : Nat), modulusMinimum B m s ≤ z → ∀ (positive : Bool),
        let q := packet top m s positive
        PreparedInput q.1 q.2 ∧
        (PacketHolds f baseline top z q ↔
          SourceCongruence f (Function.update baseline top z) m s positive)

def FullActualGreatestCongruenceRoute : Prop :=
  ExactGreatestResidueLayout ∧ ExactGreatestResidueTies ∧ ExactGreatestCongruenceShape ∧
    ExactGreatestCongruencePacket

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute

    (support : Supplied family names) (good : Valid names p) :

  intro clause used r inRow t inTerm
