greatest value; reading the chart back returns the valuation itself. -/
theorem actualChartValues (family : Family) (names : List Nat) (supports : Supplied family names)
    (p : Pattern) (member : p ∈ ActualFiniteOrderBranches.patterns names)
    (θ : Nat → Nat) (checked : (guard p).eval θ) (nonempty : 0 < dimension family)
    (C : Nat) (paid : AllPaid C family θ) :
    0 < p.1 ∧ LowerChartCondition C (top p) (realized θ p) ∧
      seed C p (realized θ p) ≤ realized θ p (top p) ∧
      readWithin names p (realized θ p) θ (realized θ p (top p)) = θ := by
  let greatest := top p
  let base := realized θ p
  obtain ⟨_,keys,bounds,onto⟩ := (exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp member
  obtain ⟨strict,slots,ties⟩ := exactBranchRealization θ names p member checked
  have width : 0 < p.1 := by
    obtain ⟨n,used⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp nonempty
    have input : n ∈ names := (supports.2 n).mpr used
    exact (Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt (ties n input).1

    obtain ⟨e,member,eq⟩ := onto i used
    have n : e.1 ∈ names := by
      rw [← keys]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,member,rfl⟩
    change C ≤ realized θ p i
    rw [← eq,(slots e member).2]
    exact paid e.1 ((supports.2 e.1).mp n)
  have topWidth : greatest < p.1 := by
    change p.1-1 < p.1
    omega
  have chart : LowerChartCondition C greatest base :=
    ⟨fun i h => payRank i (h.trans topWidth),fun i j lt _ => strict lt⟩
  have pred : rankedPredecessor greatest base ≤ base greatest := by
    by_cases zero : greatest = 0
    · simp only [rankedPredecessor,if_pos zero,Nat.zero_le]
    · rw [rankedPredecessor,if_neg zero]
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (strict (show greatest-1 < greatest by omega))
  refine ⟨width,chart,max_le (payRank greatest topWidth) pred,?_⟩
  funext n
  by_cases used : n ∈ names
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_pos used]
    change Function.update base greatest (base greatest) (rename p n) = θ n
    rw [Function.update_eq_self]
    exact (ties n used).2
  · change readWithin names p base θ (base greatest) n = θ n
    rw [readWithin,if_neg used]

  intro k used
  obtain ⟨r,member,ranked⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp used)
  rcases List.mem_append.mp member with chart | residual
  · obtain ⟨row,atChart,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp chart
    obtain ⟨term,seen,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ranked

theorem exactSuppliedHighDimension : ExactSuppliedHighDimension := by
  intro alt shaped C family names supplied result member
  obtain ⟨p,listed,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  let greatest := top p
  let qs := (packets alt p.1 greatest (ranked p family)).map (prepend greatest)
  let childFamily := child alt C family p
  have good := (exactNamedCharts names p).mp listed
  have width : p.1 ≤ dimension family := by
    have chart := ((exactPatternEnumeration names p).mp good.1).1
    rw [← checkedLength family names supplied]
    exact chart
  have core := (exactActualLowerRouteFamily (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) greatest C qs
    (amendedShapes alt shaped p family)).1
  have source := (exactGuardedResidualUnion (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) C greatest
    (outputs alt C family p)).1
  have scope (k : Nat) (inUnion : k ∈ coordinates childFamily) : k < greatest := by
    obtain ⟨clause,member,atClause⟩ := (coordinateClause childFamily k).mp inUnion
    obtain ⟨out,used,exactOut⟩ := source clause member
    change clause.map Prod.fst = guardedRows C greatest out at exactOut
    change k ∈ supportSet (clause.map Prod.fst) at atClause
    rw [exactOut] at atClause
    exact guardedBelow C greatest out (core out used) k atClause
  have subset : coordinates childFamily ⊆ Finset.range greatest :=
    fun k member => Finset.mem_range.mpr (scope k member)
  have bound : dimension childFamily ≤ greatest := by

    have pos := good.2.1
    change p.1-1 < p.1

  rw [← eq] at listed

    foldMaximum (chartCost B (encodeFamily fs)) _ p listed
  have same : chartCost B (encodeFamily fs) p = familyBound B p.1 (encodeFamily (ranked p fs)) := by
    unfold chartCost
    rw [exactRawRankCalibration]
  rw [← same]
  exact cost

    (θ : Nat → Nat) (checked : (guard p).eval θ) (nonempty : 0 < dimension family)

    0 < p.1 ∧ LowerChartCondition C (top p) (realized θ p) ∧
      seed C p (realized θ p) ≤ realized θ p (top p) ∧
      readWithin names p (realized θ p) θ (realized θ p (top p)) = θ := by

    ⟨fun i h => payRank i (h.trans topWidth),fun i j lt _ => strict lt⟩

    by_cases zero : greatest = 0

    · rw [rankedPredecessor,if_neg zero]

    rw [readWithin,if_pos used]

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacyTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierContractProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuplesRowProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuplesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridgeProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHighReadyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawMixedFamilyCeilingProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacy
open OrdinalComparison
open StageCallbackSupplier (Supplier SupplierShape SupplierExact packets outputs child compile
  stageChildren Emits exactSuppliedStageCallback)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (alternatives tuples alternativesShape exactPaidMixedRow
  exactMixedMatrixMinimum)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (choices tuplePacket)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (compileRow properClauses AdmittedLiteralClause
  properClauseMember exactLiteralMixedRowBridge)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (highPackets familyNeed highMinimum OriginalSetup
  exactOriginalLiteralReady)
open ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily (Family reifyFamily)
open ActualFiniteOrderBranches (Pattern)
open ActualBitFamilyHigh (ranked)
open ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh (charts)
open OriginalPrintedPlainMatrixLinearProjection (top)
open ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection (prepend)
open ActualGreatestRouteResidual (lowerFamily)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeBitRow encodeFamily)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (rowBound familyBound exactFamilyBound)

theorem exactLegacySupplierShape : ExactLegacySupplierShape := by
  intro r top row q used
  exact alternativesShape (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) r top 0 (compileRow row) q used

/-- The one-row family's typed need is below that row's raw majorant. -/
theorem singleNeed (B r : Nat) (row : BitRow) :
    familyNeed B r [[row]] ≤ rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) := by
  have raw : familyBound B r (encodeFamily [[row]]) = rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) := by
    show max (max (rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)) 0) 0 = rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)
    rw [Nat.max_zero,Nat.max_zero]
  exact (exactFamilyBound B r [[row]]).trans (le_of_eq raw)

theorem exactLegacySupplierExact : ExactLegacySupplierExact := by
  intro f B selected r top baseline row z admitted strict scope lower high
  have need := singleNeed B r row
  have setup : OriginalSetup B r top baseline [[row]] := by
    refine ⟨strict,?_,?_⟩
    · intro rows inFamily other inRows t inTerms
      have e1 : rows = [row] := List.mem_singleton.mp inFamily
      rw [e1] at inRows
      have e2 : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows
      rw [e2] at inTerms
      exact scope t inTerms
    · intro _ _ _ _ t _ below
      exact need.trans (lower t.2.rank below)
  have payment : highMinimum B r top baseline [[row]] ≤ z :=
    max_le (need.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high)
  have clause : AdmittedLiteralClause [row] := by
    intro other inRows
    have e : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows
    rw [e]
    exact admitted
  have member : [row] ∈ properClauses [[row]] :=
    (properClauseMember [[row]] [row]).mpr ⟨List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,clause⟩
  have ready := exactOriginalLiteralReady B r top baseline [[row]] setup z payment [row] member
  have here : compileRow row ∈ [row].map compileRow :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,rfl⟩
  have minimum := (exactMixedMatrixMinimum B r top baseline ([row].map compileRow) z).mp
    ready.2.2 (compileRow row) here
  have literal := exactLiteralMixedRowBridge f B selected (Function.update baseline top z) row
    admitted (ready.1 row (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl))
  have routed := exactPaidMixedRow f B selected r top baseline (compileRow row)
    (ready.2.1 (compileRow row) here) z minimum
  exact literal.trans routed

theorem legacyPackets (r top : Nat) (family : Family) :
    packets legacy r top family = highPackets r top family := by
  have rowsEq (rows : List BitRow) :
      rows.map (legacy r top) = (rows.map compileRow).map (alternatives r top) := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    rfl
  show (properClauses family).flatMap
      (fun rows => (choices (rows.map (legacy r top))).map tuplePacket) =
    (properClauses family).flatMap
      (fun rows => (choices ((rows.map compileRow).map (alternatives r top))).map tuplePacket)
  simp only [rowsEq]

theorem exactLegacyLiteralCompile : ExactLegacyLiteralCompile := by
  refine ⟨legacyPackets,?_⟩
  intro C family names
  have childEq (p : Pattern) :
      child legacy C family p = ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.child C family p := by
    show reifyFamily C (top p) (lowerFamily (top p) C
        ((packets legacy p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)).map (prepend (top p)))) =
      reifyFamily C (top p) (lowerFamily (top p) C
        ((highPackets p.1 (top p) (ranked p family)).map (prepend (top p))))
    rw [legacyPackets]
  show (charts names).map (fun p => (p,child legacy C family p)) =
    (charts names).map (fun p => (p,ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.child C family p))
  simp only [childEq]

theorem exactLegacyStageCallback : ExactLegacyStageCallback := by
  intro f B selected high emits
  exact exactSuppliedStageCallback f B legacy exactLegacySupplierShape
    (exactLegacySupplierExact f B selected) high emits

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacy

1	module
2	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ClosedOrdinaryFieldTargets
3	public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion.LinearRowsCodeDefinitions
4	
5	@[expose] public section
6	namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.PreparedProjection
7	open OrdinalComparison
8	open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
9	open FieldComparison
10	
11	/-- Name zero is the natural coordinate eliminated by the kernel. Every
12	positive name is the original table position plus one. The raw packet
13	retains the byte code of the table, including unused or repeated slots. -/
14	abbrev PreparedPacketCode := Nat × Nat
15	
16	def eliminatePreparedCode (p : PreparedPacketCode) : PreparedPacketCode :=
17	  (p.1,LinearRows.Code.eliminate 0 p.2)
18	
19	def eliminatePreparedFormula (p : NormalForm.Formula) : NormalForm.Formula :=
20	  LinearRows.eliminate 0 p
21	
22	inductive LowerOperand where
23	  | coordinate (rank : Nat)
24	  | ordinary (rank : Nat) (field : ValueField)
25	  | count (rank : Nat) (lam mu : NONote)
26	
27	def LowerOperand.rank : LowerOperand → Nat
28	  | .coordinate rank | .ordinary rank _ | .count rank _ _ => rank
29	
30	/-- Literal table encoding. Tags distinguish raw coordinate, ordinary
31	field, and count. Original rank and endpoint/iterate bytes are retained. -/
32	abbrev LowerOperandCode := Nat × Nat × LongFieldCode
33	
34	def LowerOperand.code : LowerOperand → LowerOperandCode
35	  | .coordinate rank => (0,rank,(0,0,0,0))
36	  | .ordinary rank field => (1,rank,longFieldCode field)
37	  | .count rank lam mu => (2,rank,longFieldCode (.entry 0 lam mu))
38	
39	def preparedTableBytes (table : List LowerOperand) : Nat :=
40	  Encodable.encode (table.map LowerOperand.code)
41	
42	def preparedPacketCode (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) : PreparedPacketCode :=
43	  (preparedTableBytes table,p.encode)
44	
45	/-- Every literal row occurrence, including one with coefficient zero,
46	has the plain-variable constructor. A positive name must address the
47	unchanged table; name zero is reserved for the quantified natural. -/
48	def PlainPreparedFormula (p : NormalForm.Formula) : Prop :=
49	  ∀ a ∈ LinearRows.atoms p, ∀ s ∈ a.row.2, ∃ i : Nat, s.2 = .variable i
50	
51	def PreparedInput (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) : Prop :=
52	  PlainPreparedFormula p ∧ ∀ i ∈ p.variables, i ≤ table.length
53	
54	def PreparedProjectionCodeExact : Prop :=
55	  Primrec eliminatePreparedCode ∧
56	  (∀ p : PreparedPacketCode, (eliminatePreparedCode p).1 = p.1) ∧
57	  (∀ (bytes : Nat) (p : NormalForm.Formula),
58	    eliminatePreparedCode (bytes,p.encode) = (bytes,(eliminatePreparedFormula p).encode)) ∧
59	  ∀ (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula),
60	    eliminatePreparedCode (preparedPacketCode table p) =
61	      preparedPacketCode table (eliminatePreparedFormula p)
62	
63	def PreparedProjectionSyntax : Prop :=
64	  ∀ (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula), PreparedInput table p →
65	    LinearRows.isLinear 0 p = true ∧
66	    PlainPreparedFormula (eliminatePreparedFormula p) ∧
67	    (∀ i : Nat, i ∈ (eliminatePreparedFormula p).variables ↔ i ≠ 0 ∧ i ∈ p.variables) ∧
68	    ∀ i ∈ (eliminatePreparedFormula p).variables, 0 < i ∧ i ≤ table.length
69	
70	/-- First prove equivalence for arbitrary natural slot assignments.
71	No assumed realizability and no independent existential on slot values. -/
72	def PreparedProjectionActual : Prop :=
73	  ∀ (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula), PreparedInput table p →
74	  ∀ ν : Nat → Nat, (eliminatePreparedFormula p).eval ν ↔
75	    ∃ z : Nat, p.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)
76	
77	noncomputable def lowerOperandRead (f : Nat → Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (op : LowerOperand) :
78	    ClosedNaturalFieldResult :=
79	  match op with
80	  | .coordinate rank => some (some (ρ rank))
81	  | .ordinary rank field => closedOrdinaryValueField f (longFieldCode field) (ρ rank)
82	  | .count rank lam mu =>
83	      closedOrdinaryCountField f (rawNoteEncode lam.1,rawNoteEncode mu.1,ρ rank)
84	
85	def LowerOperandActual (f : Nat → Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (op : LowerOperand) (v : Nat) : Prop :=
86	  match op with
87	  | .coordinate rank => v = ρ rank
88	  | .ordinary rank field =>
89	      ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain field (ρ rank) ∧ FieldValue f field (ρ rank) v
90	  | .count rank lam mu =>
91	      ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain (.entry 0 lam mu) (ρ rank) ∧
92	        FirstEntry f (countInitial lam.1.repr (ρ rank)) mu.1.repr v
93	
94	/-- All slots read from one actual raw valuation. Ranks strictly below
95	the eliminated rank may repeat; repeated occurrences never receive

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ClosedOrdinaryFieldTargets
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion.LinearRowsCodeDefinitions

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.PreparedProjection
open OrdinalComparison
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open FieldComparison

/-- Name zero is the natural coordinate eliminated by the kernel. Every
positive name is the original table position plus one. The raw packet
retains the byte code of the table, including unused or repeated slots. -/
abbrev PreparedPacketCode := Nat × Nat

def eliminatePreparedCode (p : PreparedPacketCode) : PreparedPacketCode :=
  (p.1,LinearRows.Code.eliminate 0 p.2)

def eliminatePreparedFormula (p : NormalForm.Formula) : NormalForm.Formula :=
  LinearRows.eliminate 0 p

inductive LowerOperand where
  | coordinate (rank : Nat)
  | ordinary (rank : Nat) (field : ValueField)
  | count (rank : Nat) (lam mu : NONote)

def LowerOperand.rank : LowerOperand → Nat
  | .coordinate rank | .ordinary rank _ | .count rank _ _ => rank

/-- Literal table encoding. Tags distinguish raw coordinate, ordinary
field, and count. Original rank and endpoint/iterate bytes are retained. -/
abbrev LowerOperandCode := Nat × Nat × LongFieldCode

def LowerOperand.code : LowerOperand → LowerOperandCode
  | .coordinate rank => (0,rank,(0,0,0,0))
  | .ordinary rank field => (1,rank,longFieldCode field)
  | .count rank lam mu => (2,rank,longFieldCode (.entry 0 lam mu))

def preparedTableBytes (table : List LowerOperand) : Nat :=
  Encodable.encode (table.map LowerOperand.code)

def preparedPacketCode (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) : PreparedPacketCode :=
  (preparedTableBytes table,p.encode)

/-- Every literal row occurrence, including one with coefficient zero,
has the plain-variable constructor. A positive name must address the
unchanged table; name zero is reserved for the quantified natural. -/
def PlainPreparedFormula (p : NormalForm.Formula) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ LinearRows.atoms p, ∀ s ∈ a.row.2, ∃ i : Nat, s.2 = .variable i

def PreparedInput (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) : Prop :=
  PlainPreparedFormula p ∧ ∀ i ∈ p.variables, i ≤ table.length

def PreparedProjectionCodeExact : Prop :=
  Primrec eliminatePreparedCode ∧
  (∀ p : PreparedPacketCode, (eliminatePreparedCode p).1 = p.1) ∧
  (∀ (bytes : Nat) (p : NormalForm.Formula),
    eliminatePreparedCode (bytes,p.encode) = (bytes,(eliminatePreparedFormula p).encode)) ∧
  ∀ (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula),
    eliminatePreparedCode (preparedPacketCode table p) =
      preparedPacketCode table (eliminatePreparedFormula p)

def PreparedProjectionSyntax : Prop :=
  ∀ (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula), PreparedInput table p →
    LinearRows.isLinear 0 p = true ∧
    PlainPreparedFormula (eliminatePreparedFormula p) ∧
    (∀ i : Nat, i ∈ (eliminatePreparedFormula p).variables ↔ i ≠ 0 ∧ i ∈ p.variables) ∧
    ∀ i ∈ (eliminatePreparedFormula p).variables, 0 < i ∧ i ≤ table.length

/-- First prove equivalence for arbitrary natural slot assignments.
No assumed realizability and no independent existential on slot values. -/
def PreparedProjectionActual : Prop :=
  ∀ (table : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula), PreparedInput table p →
  ∀ ν : Nat → Nat, (eliminatePreparedFormula p).eval ν ↔
    ∃ z : Nat, p.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)

noncomputable def lowerOperandRead (f : Nat → Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (op : LowerOperand) :
    ClosedNaturalFieldResult :=
  match op with
  | .coordinate rank => some (some (ρ rank))
  | .ordinary rank field => closedOrdinaryValueField f (longFieldCode field) (ρ rank)
  | .count rank lam mu =>
      closedOrdinaryCountField f (rawNoteEncode lam.1,rawNoteEncode mu.1,ρ rank)

def LowerOperandActual (f : Nat → Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (op : LowerOperand) (v : Nat) : Prop :=
  match op with
  | .coordinate rank => v = ρ rank
  | .ordinary rank field =>
      ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain field (ρ rank) ∧ FieldValue f field (ρ rank) v
  | .count rank lam mu =>
      ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain (.entry 0 lam mu) (ρ rank) ∧
        FirstEntry f (countInitial lam.1.repr (ρ rank)) mu.1.repr v

/-- All slots read from one actual raw valuation. Ranks strictly below
the eliminated rank may repeat; repeated occurrences never receive
independent assignments. Every supplied lower value must really exist. -/
def PreparedTableTied (f : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat)
    (table : List LowerOperand) (ν : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < table.length),
    let op := table.get ⟨j,hj⟩
    op.rank < zRank ∧ LowerOperandActual f ρ op (ν (j+1))

def PreparedTiedProjection : Prop :=
  (∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (op : LowerOperand) (v : Nat),
    lowerOperandRead f ρ op = some (some v) ↔ LowerOperandActual f ρ op v) ∧
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (table : List LowerOperand)
      (p : NormalForm.Formula) (ν : Nat → Nat),
    PreparedInput table p → PreparedTableTied f zRank ρ table ν →
    (∀ z : Nat, PreparedTableTied f zRank (Function.update ρ zRank z) table (Function.update ν 0 z)) ∧
    ((eliminatePreparedFormula p).eval ν ↔
      ∃ z : Nat, PreparedTableTied f zRank (Function.update ρ zRank z) table (Function.update ν 0 z) ∧
        p.eval (Function.update ν 0 z))

/-- Prepared one-variable row projection only, not the preparation,
finite strips, or any whole arithmetic/QE theorem. -/
def FullPreparedParameterProjection : Prop :=
  PreparedProjectionCodeExact ∧ PreparedProjectionSyntax ∧
    PreparedProjectionActual ∧ PreparedTiedProjection

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.PreparedProjection

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixLinearLowerTableTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPlainTerminalMatrixTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalProjectedMatrixDecode
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection (LowerOperand PreparedInput)
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open HeterogeneousSignedMatrixSlice (Row)
open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test)

abbrev Summand := Int × NormalForm.Summand

def decodeTerm (ops : List LowerOperand) (t : Summand) : Option WeightedOperand :=
  match t.2 with
  | .variable 0 => none
  | .variable (j+1) => ops[j]?.map (fun op => (t.1,op))
  | _ => none

def decodeTerms (ops : List LowerOperand) : List Summand → Option (List WeightedOperand)
  | [] => some []
  | t :: ts => do
      let term ← decodeTerm ops t
      let rest ← decodeTerms ops ts
      pure (term :: rest)

def testOf : NormalForm.Atom → Test
  | .nonnegative _ => .nonnegative
  | .divisible m _ => .congruence (m+1)

def decodeAtom (ops : List LowerOperand) (a : NormalForm.Atom) : Option Row :=
  (decodeTerms ops a.row.2).map (fun ts => (testOf a,a.row.1,ts))

def decodeAtoms (ops : List LowerOperand) : List NormalForm.Atom → Option (List Row)
  | [] => some []
  | a :: atoms => do
      let row ← decodeAtom ops a
      let rest ← decodeAtoms ops atoms
      pure (row :: rest)

def decode (ops : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) : Option (List Row) :=
  decodeAtoms ops (LinearRows.atoms p)

def FitsOutput (ops : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) : Prop :=
  PreparedInput ops p ∧ ∀ n ∈ p.variables, 0 < n

def LiteralTerm (ops : List LowerOperand) (t : Summand) (out : WeightedOperand) : Prop :=
  ∃ j : Nat, ∃ h : j < ops.length,
    t.2 = .variable (j+1) ∧ out = (t.1,ops[j])

def LiteralRow (ops : List LowerOperand) (a : NormalForm.Atom) (row : Row) : Prop :=
  row.1 = testOf a ∧ row.2.1 = a.row.1 ∧ List.Forall₂ (LiteralTerm ops) a.row.2 row.2.2

def ExactProjectedMatrixDecode : Prop :=
  (∀ (ops : List LowerOperand) (t : Summand) (o : WeightedOperand),
    decodeTerm ops t = some o ↔ LiteralTerm ops t o) ∧
  (∀ (ops : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula) (rows : List Row),
    decode ops p = some rows ↔ List.Forall₂ (LiteralRow ops) (LinearRows.atoms p) rows) ∧
  ∀ (ops : List LowerOperand) (p : NormalForm.Formula), FitsOutput ops p →
    ∃ rows : List Row, decode ops p = some rows

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalProjectedMatrixDecode

greatest value under the raw row majorant, then the Cartesian-joined, projected, reified compiler
built from it has both directions of the callback and strict dimension decrease at `stageBound`, and
`HighAtStage` holds for any raw program emitting its encoded children. `STAGE-CALLBACK-LEGACY` shows
the accepted typed alternatives meet that interface and that the generic compiler then equals the
accepted `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile` as an ordered list.

independent obligations, both stated against frozen definitions:

`SupplierExact f B alt` — this is handoff item (a) in full (per-row guards characterising genuine
reads and terminal polarity, both directions), and it is *not* started;

   carry the node's own active/zero status from `ActualRawCanonicalNode.nodeCode`, and that needs a
   new typed statement first.

## What passed

| Key | Gate module | Receipt | Aliases |

| `STAGE-CALLBACK-SUPPLIER` | `LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierStatementChecks` | `1795383321915397551-3140006` | 7 |

All twelve aliases print `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. Both Targets files are unchanged since their freeze (receipt `1795382871845342259-3137004`).

- **`STAGE-CALLBACK-SUPPLIER`** — main theorem `fixed_exactSuppliedStageCallback : ExactSuppliedStageCallback`. For any per-row packet list `alt` with shaped packets and row-level exactness under the raw row majorant (`SupplierExact f B alt`), the compiler built from it has both callback directions and strict dimension decrease at `stageBound`. That compiler is the Cartesian join, then predecessor guard, projection at the shared greatest value, decoding and reification. Hence `HighAtStage f B high (stageChildren alt B)` for every `high` meeting the literal emission equation `Emits alt B high`. This is handoff items (b) and (c), done once and generically.
- **`STAGE-CALLBACK-LEGACY`** — the accepted typed alternatives satisfy that interface for every selected control, and the generic compiler then equals `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile` as an ordered list. This only shows the interface is inhabited; it gives no computable `high`.

## What failed

One gate, receipt `1795383119436183476-3138815`: `StageCallbackSupplierChartProof` had a hypothesis named `scoped`, which is a keyword. I renamed it and re-gated; the failed text is kept under `drafts/fable2/`. No mathematical route failed.

## What is still open

The callback is not closed. The gap is now two independent obligations against frozen definitions:

1. An emittable supplier with `SupplierShape` and `SupplierExact` — this is handoff item (a) in full, and it is not started.
2. A computable `high` with `Emits alt B high`.

The legacy supplier meets the first but cannot meet the second, because it is the old `Finset`-ordered route list.

One finding that shaped the interface: canonical funding needs `inputSignBoundCode`, which is larger than the typed `terminalCutoffCeiling`. So `SupplierExact` offers the raw `rowBound` (which `stageBound` dominates), not the typed need.

## Next

1. Read whether `ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet` is already literal-order, so modular rows can reuse it.
2. Guard exactness on the canonical label order from `exactFiniteFullValueGuards`.
3. Completeness from #1384, then soundness. Soundness is the step I expect to be hardest: proper prefixes of a genuine trace are also emitted and must get false terminals.
4. Survey raw forms for the emission equation before fixing the packet syntax. Projection already has a primitive-recursive code form and `decode` is a plain `def`, so those two are not the blocker.

## For root

- Prefix `StageCallback`; seven new `.lean` files under `LogicLineages/PermittedControl/`.
- The two Targets files were written about a minute before the ledger recorded the prefix; the ledger says so.
- The accepted-record numbers listed in the supplier evidence file are my reading of which bundles own the imported proofs; please confirm against the register before citing them.
